title: Real Space - Planetary Stations
description:
Planetary Stations version 1.5.15

This version is compatible with patch 4.4 Pegasus.

[table]
[tr]
[th][url=boosty.to/annatar108] [img]https://imgur.com/ZEBNNJB.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=discord.gg/tCpXcNs] [img]https://imgur.com/K3aIvKq.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=vk.com/realspacemod] [img]https://imgur.com/dwMExTS.png[/img][/url][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EjzuguR.png[/img]

The main feature of this mod is the ability to colonize uninhabited worlds. Unlike other similar mods, the goal of this mod is not just to open up the possibility of colonization, but to make it a harmonious part of the gameplay, without seriously distorting the balance of the game. To do this, a new type of colonization - Planetary Stations - was created, similar to the Habitats. Planetary stations are relatively small settlements that are available from the beginning of the game for some types of planets. These stations are expensive to build and maintain, but have many resource production bonuses and other unique features. Stations have special special specializations, districts, and buildings. The size of planetary stations is much smaller than planets and this severely limits the number of inhabitants, but is compensated for by low population growth.

[b]Station types:[/b]

[list]
    [*] Energy Station
    [*] Mining Station
    [*] Research Station
    [*] Civilian/Transit Station
    [*] Industrial Station
    [*] Military Station
    [*] Resort/Temple/Unity Station
    [*] Prison Station
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vREipmy.png[/img]

[list]
    [*]This mod does not support achievements.
    [*]Although the required items are listed on this page, this mod can be used separately. Real Space and New Frontiers are not required at this time. Not having these mods will not cause bugs, but common items may appear in future updates.
    [*]This mod does not allow access to colonizing all uninhabited worlds. In future updates, new technologies for colonizing new types of worlds and other features will be added.
    [*]This mod can be turned on at any point in the game. A new game is not required. 
    [*]Compatibility with other mods should not cause major problems. The minimum number of elements that can be used by other elements has been used.
    [*]For mod creators, use the planetary_stations flag to identify planets with stations.
    [*]Some elements of this mod may well not work as planned. It will take some time for testing to polish things up. I would welcome any help and advice on my [url=discord.gg/tCpXcNs]Discord[/url]. Unfortunately right now I have almost no time to find all the bugs myself and adjust the balance.
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/8hXVs7X.png[/img]

[b]My work is completely dependent on your donations. I have a lot of plans, friends, but they will be realized only thanks to you.[/b]

[i]As of late, Patreon no longer works for me. I can only get your help through [url=boosty.to/annatar108]Boosty[/url] and am switching to the new support model. You can now choose which project to support. I will be able to start upgrading as soon as we raise the necessary amount. The good news is that updates will appear immediately on Steam and will be available to everyone.[/i]

[url=boosty.to/annatar108][img]https://imgur.com/TA1b8DC.png[/img][/url]

title: Elves of Stellaris
description:
Adds custom space elves with new: portraits, outfits, hairstyles, ships, city styles, flags, name lists, megastructures, traits, civics, events, and way too much more to put in a tiny blurb like this. 

Перевод на русский язык предоставлен Aregemoth и tzverg!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748986599]日本語訳[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]La traduction en français est disponible ici![/url]

[img=https://i.postimg.cc/C1PVwPQd/Features.png]

[h2][b]Ships[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Elven[/b][/h3]
Naboo meets Imperial themed ship set. With elfy vines. Or something. All vanilla ships, civilian stations, and select megastructures included.
[/list]

[h2][b]Portraits[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Elven[/b][/h3]
A variety of elf portraits with varying clothes and color options.[*][h3][b]Dark Elven[/b][/h3]
Several sets of dark elves to antagonize the other elves.
[/list]

[h2][b]Origins[/b][/h2]
[list][*][h3][b]Elven Foundations[/b][/h3][list][*]Your people came of age on a world populated with the many wonders of an ancient Eldar empire.
[*][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]Custom Star Cluster[*]Has Elven Ruined Orbital Ring on Homeworld[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Arcadian Symbiosis[/b][/h3][list][*]Your civilization arose as a grouping of sparsely populated natural habitats cowexisting with sentient plantlife.
[*][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]Custom Star Cluster[*]Treants coexist on your world[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Celestial Throne[/b][/h3][list][*]Many millennia have passed since this civilisation found everlasting peace and eternal life at the end of a long journey, and the start of an even longer exile.\nLong enough to forget that no dream truly lasts forever.
[*][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]Custom event chain: The Day You Vanished with the Stars[*]Custom Ridiculously Large and Psychotically Colorful Home System[*]Homeworld Unique Megastructure: Eternal Array[*]Starts with Unique Relic[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Sunless Realms[/b][/h3][list][*]Miraculously blossoming in a system with binary black holes, your civilizatin’s only light ahs been that of the divine Moon.
[*][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]Custom Star Cluster[*]Homeworld: Permafrost World[*]2 Additional Permafrost Worlds in Home System[*]Note: This origin is specifically made for building tall![/list][/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Subterranean Inception[/b][/h3][list][*]For millenia your civilization existed in the vast caverns of your homeworld. Eventually breaching the surface your people are now ready to break through another barrier: space itself.
[*][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]Suitably Dark Elven Custom Star Cluster with Creepy Megastructure Habitat[*]Homeworld: Speleoterrestrial World[*]2 Additional Permafrost Worlds in Home System[*]Note: Creepy Megastructure can be repaired via a Decision with the right tech![/list][/list][/list]

[h2][b]Elven Names Lists[/b][/h2]
[list][*]7 Elven and 3 Drow namelists. Ayleid, Quenya, Sindarin, Altmer, and some randomish stuff. Drow have real Drow, Dunmer, and a sort of mixed list. [/list]

[img=https://i.postimg.cc/sg7y5Jv0/Patches.png]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2274459608]Spawns… ENABLED![/url] Adds Elven Fallen Empires, elven primitives, and allows default spawning of existing elven empires.
[/list]

[h1][b]Other[/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3409850104]Elvens ships, but BLACK![/url][/list]

[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2846894747]Gigastructures people!![/url][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810489542]NSC Patch!![/url][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=2929459614]NSC + Downscaled Patch![/url][/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=916315643][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZdJ9719/Nessassity-Banner.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]We have a Discord Server! Join us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/ftvPPu53dG]here[/url]! [/b][/h1]

[img=https://i.postimg.cc/65XHbL3v/FAQTNR.png]
[list][*][h1][b]I want a patch for X super cool mod![/b][/h1][i]That’s great! Go make it! :-D We found supporting too many patches seriously cut into the development time we had available for the main mod. We will be happy to post any patches people make up at the top of the description however. Let us know about any patches you make in the comments![/i][*][h1][b]I want the version of this mod for some silly past version of Stellaris!![/b][/h1][i]There is no past version of stellaris. There has only been and only will be THIS version. Suggestions of past versions are clearly Blorg conspiracy theories.[/i][*][h1][b]Hey! The games says this mod is for some stupid OLD version of Stellaris! What gives!?[/b][/h1][i]Try deleting your <My Documents>/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/mod folder (but make sure you don’t trash non-steam mods if you have any). title: Automatic Pop Migration [Outated - 2.2]
description:
Ambit has brought the mod up to 3.1+: Get it here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2591166867

Is manually shifting around pops that are out of work and homeless getting you down? Want to get back to conquering the galaxy? This mod will find new planets for your out of work homeless pops so you don't have to. 

[h1]Future[/h1]
There are no planned updates to this mod. 

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][h1]Turn on or off Automatic Pop Migration from the decisions panel on your capital world.[/h1]
[*]Policy to determine if only targeting unemployed and overcrowded pops or all unemployed pops
[*]Policy to set habitability preference - either the default 60% minimum, an 80% minimum or allow any habitability
[*]Policy to force migrate based on low habitability. regardless of employment or housing status. A maximum of 3 pops per month. The last pop on planet will not move. [b][u]NOTE: Increased risk of building destruction![u][b]
[*]Only resettles pops that are allowed to migrate.
[*]Also works for machine empires where migration is not allowed
[*]Cost per pop approximates resettlement cost which is defined at a job category level and is influenced by certain traits, civics, and traditions and will cost from 12.5 - 225 energy per pop .
[*]Finds new planets based on best habitability and won't move pops to planets with less than 60% habitability, if set by policy.
[*]New planets must have available housing and jobs.
[*]Can use a planet decision set a single planet as the preferred location for pops to move to. This costs 25 influence and 1000 energy to set. Planet must still have a habitability of greater or equal to 60% for the pop to move there if set by policy.
[*]Can use a planet decision to set planets to have a research, mining, food, or energy focus at the cost of 10 influence per planet. Pops that have traits that boost these jobs will be more likely to settle there. 
[*]Can use a planet decision to migrate Toilers from Thrall-Worlds at the cost of 10 influence per planet.
[*]Can set a planet as not allowing pops to migrate in the context of Automatic Pop Migration.
[*]Can set a planet to move all homeless pops, regardless of employment, starting with the lowest strata and moving upwards.
[*]Can set a planet to allow assimilating pops to migrate to other worlds.
[*]Job Retraining Campaign edict to reduce the time a newly unemployed specialist / ruler take to demote to a lower job category. It only works on people unemployed after the campaign is active.
[*]Moving occurs on the 3rd of the month to lessen the strain on 1st day of the month game processing.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
No vanilla files were harmed in making this mod.
[i]Compatible with Stellaris v2.2.* (Le Guin)[/i]
As with any mod that affects game play, NOT achievement compatible.

If you like this mod, please come back to rate and favorite.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
Without rating this mod it's much harder for others to find it. If you have feedback, please leave it in a comment below.

[h1]Bugs, Feedback and Suggestions[/h1]
You can post comments here or in the [url=https://discord.gg/K9QKv6C]Discord channel for my mods[/url]. I take all constructive feedback and suggestions seriously.

[h1]Patch Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1659123817]German Translation[/url] - thank you Cytron and killy!
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1639488675]Chinese Translation - 自动人口移居 - 简体中文[/url] - thank you oblevdorohmsic!
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1375388095]Russian Translation[/url] - Thank you to «(PeGaS)»!
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1664871954]Japanese Translation[/url] - Thank you mikaduki!
[/list]

Thanks to Rimweasel for the Ignore Free Jobs policy addition. 
Thanks to the Stellaris User Mod forum and the Discord Stellaris Modding Den for all the help and support.
[url=https://discord.gg/CMjnnET][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

title: Tier Numbers: Buildings
description:
I always had troubles to distinguish different tiers of Factories, Foundries and Research Labs, their icons look almost the same. Hovering mouse over and viewing tooltips is not very convenient. That's why I decided to make this little mod, mostly for myself. 
Then I decided to include here all types of buildings which have tiers.

Very simple mod, you will see building tier number in lower right corner of building icon.
Compatible with Ironman and Achievements.

Updated for 4.1

You also may want to look at Tier Number: Buildings add-on for Additional Vanilla Buildings mod: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2632716184

title: ZBeautiful Battles
description:
This mod improves the battle aesthetics of the game by making changes that
alter the flow and spacing of space battles in Stellaris. 

- Updated for Stellaris version 2.2 Le Guin (0d1c)
- Mod version 4.4 (PLEASE REFER TO CHANGELOG FOR DETAILS!!!!!!!)

-COMMON\SHIP_BEHAVIORS\STANDARD_SHIP_BEHAVIORS.TXT
	* Ship behavior tweaked by changing collision awareness, prefered 
	attack range, formation distance and return to formation distance.	
-COMMON\SHIP_BEHAVIORS\00_STRIKE_CRAFT.TXT
	* Increased Engagement & Return range to make fighters engage properly instead of
	flying outwards.
-COMMON\DEFINES\01_DEFINES.LUA (Should not be overwritable - custom file name)
	* Increased combat_back_off rate for better spacing in close combat.
	* Increased Fleet Base Formation Scale by a small amount to space out ships in 
	pre combat / sublight / lightspeed formation.
	* Decreased Fleet Base Formation Div by a small amount to space out ships in	
	pre combat / sublight / lightspeed formation. 	
	* Increased Ship / Fighter random height offset by a large amount. 
	* Decreased Trail durations for Fighters / Ships / Missiles for less visual noise.
	* Increased Strike craft regen to make them more practical / present.	
-COMMON\SHIP_SIZES\00_SHIP_SIZES.TXT & ALL OTHER SHIP_SIZES.TXT FILES
	* Ship speed was reduced to allow for less blobbing & more long range 
	exchange of fire.
	* Ship rotation speed was reduced to eliminate unrealistic / jittery turning 
	behavior.
-COMMON\COMPONENT_TEMPLATES\00_LEVIATHANS_WEAPONS & 00_STRIKE_CRAFT.TXT (AND OTHERS)
	* Strikecraft COMBAT speed was reduced to visualize them better / mesh with Ship speed
	reductions.
	* Strikecraft COMBAT rotation speed was reduced to eliminate unrealistic / jittery turning 
	behavior.
-GFX\PROJECTILES\BALLISTICS.TXT, LASERS.TXT, POINTDEFENSE.TXT, XL_WEAPONS.TXT, ETC
	* Decreased duration of all Beam / Laser / Bulletstream weapons for less visual clutter.	
	* Increased duration of Kinetic projectile weapons to visualize better.	
	* Decreased speed of Kinetic projectile weapons to visualize better.		
-GFX\MODELS\SHIPS\ARTHROPOID_01.TXT, HUMANOID_01.TXT, ETC	
	* Decreased size of cruiser & destroyer slightly for each faction.			
	* Decreased size of corvette by a larger amount for each faction.		
	* Battleships untouched.		
	
The above listed changes alter the battle flow and graphics in a pronounced way and
(IMHO) vastly improve the visual quality of battles in Stellaris. With these changes 
the following should be experienced:::  
	- Battles are more 3D now!!!
	- Battles are clearer and ships move in less jarring ways.  
	- Much less clipping of ships and generally more space between ships.
	- Projectiles, Fighters are generally easier to notice after secondary visual
	clutter greatly reduced (trails, beam weapon persistance, etc)

	
COMPATIBILITY
Achievement Compatible :: Not compatible.
Save game Compatible :: Should be compatible but no guarantees.

title: Dedicated Worlds
description:
Have you ever wanted to focus your planets? Create an Agri World to feed your people, a Fortress World on the edge of your space or a planet-wide city? This mod provides several types of dedicated paths for colonies, meant to give each planet a unique feel. 

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*]9 Focus Types for colonies & capital: Agriculture, Trade, Mining, Fortress, Prison, Research, Recruiting, Culture, Forge & Government Capital. ([i][url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/844630489/141136086917433443/]Press this link for detailed stats & descriptions.[/url][/i])
[*]The ability to focus and unfocus worlds.
[*]Mining worlds gain the Stripped World modifier, preventing it from becoming an Agri World or a Cultural World.
[*]2 New Megastructures: The Ecumenopolis and the Cybernetic Core. Taking four stages over approximately 10 years to construct and 14,000 minerals, it provides a planet and empire wide modifier when completed which significantly boosts the planet in all aspects. The Cybernetic Core has similar stats but is only available to Machine Empires and vice versa.
[*]Localisation in English, German and Russian[/list]

[h1]Planned Features[/h1]
[list][*]Expanded unique features for each type.
[*]Consequences for losing certain planets such as Government Capitals.
[*]The longer a world remains focused on one type, the more potent its bonuses are and are lost if changed.
[/list]

[h1]Compatiblity[/h1]
No changes to vanilla files, should be compatible will all mods and works with saved games.

[h1]Credits & Special thanks to:[/h1]
[i][list][*]All artwork belongs to their respective owners

[/list][/i]

title: Technology Ascendant
description:
[h1][b]Dynamic Research[/b][/h1]
Have you ever felt technology across the galaxy was too equal? No one rising to the top in a certain field, but lagging behind in others? Do you miss institutions from EU4? I know I do. 

This adds thirteen breakthrough technologies, one for each specialization (particles, materials, biology, etc) that dramatically increase research speed in that field, along with other unique empire bonuses. They are incredibly rare, likely to originally spawn in a single empire across the course of the game. 

This mod predates the short lived breakthrough system from the 3.11 Technology Open beta- it is considerably different both in intent and implementation.

[h1]New Mechanics[/h1]
Breakthroughs have a unique spread system, and depending on your relationship with your neighbors you are more or less likely to learn their secrets over time. The goal is that different parts of the galaxy may end up specializing in entirely different fields, with one empire far ahead in biology and society while in an opposite corner another empire is on the cutting edge in physics.

Each breakthrough is more likely to spawn under different ethics and traditions, with bonuses for specific ascension perks, and scientist skills, making it nearly impossible to spawn all of the breakthroughs yourself, and hopefully spreading different technology boosts across the galaxy. However, having a research pact with a neighbor who has a breakthrough will do far more for you than stacking all the perfect modifiers to spawn the technology yourself. Once a breakthrough appears, it will begin to spread. All neighboring empires will have dramatically increased chances of drawing that tech and friendly empires will get double the spread bonus. The Enigmatic Engineering perk however will block breakthrough spread.

[h1]Specialization[/h1]
Over time, your empire will specialize depending on the technologies you choose. This happens because every breakthrough that you take in Engineering will slightly decrease your chances of drawing a breakthrough in the other fields Society and Physics, or visa versa. Hive and Machine empires ignore this specialization rule to balance out the fact that they do not have any ethics that can boost spawn chance of a specific breakthrough, and that they are less likely to have friendly neighbors to share tech with. Hives and Machines will generally have a slightly lower chance of spawning breakthroughs at the start of the game, but should catch up as other empires begin to acquire specialization maluses.

Breakthroughs do not appear in the tech pool as regular techs, instead they are added by an event that rolls your breakthrough chances when you complete any technology. A pop up with flavor text will appear when a breakthrough may be researched, giving you a chance to accept or decline that breakthrough. You can only have one breakthrough available at a time. When other empires discover breakthroughs, you will be notified and have a situation log entry that explains what the breakthrough does, what your chances of getting it are, and what you can do to improve them. There is also mapmode added that shows the number of breakthroughs each empire has.

Espionage can aid in acquiring breakthroughs known by your rivals. Having a scientist asset from a foreign empire with a breakthrough will multiply your chances of discovering it yourself.

Since the mod works by boosting research speed, you will complete the tech tree faster than in a usual game. To balance this, I usually play with the game start slider for tech/tradition cost at 1.25x or 1.5x.

[h1]Other Features[/h1]
New Research Philosophy Policy. Steer your planetary research labs towards a particular field, hoping to get the breakthrough you want sooner, or perhaps, balancing out your research once you've made a few. Research policy is also a stand alone mod.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1592149666]Technology Repeated[/url] has been fully spun off into a separate mod. It is not required.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
Few vanilla files were harmed in the making of this mod, so it is in theory compatible with nearly everything.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3058069056]Compatibility Patch[/url] for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2602025201]Stellaris Evolved[/url]. 

Since spread modifiers are tied heavily to ethics, leader traits, traditions, and ascension perks, any other mod that adds those may change the balance of this mod. It will still work seamlessly, but breakthrough spread will likely be slower since empires and scientists will have modded traits that do not boost tech spread. 

Minor tweak to the game rule "can_species_be_assebmled" to block assembly of psionic robots with Deus Ex Machina breakthrough

The mod can be installed mid-save.

If you miss tiles terribly here is a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1596095420]Legacy 2.1.* Version[/url]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
If you would like to help translate let me know and I will link and credit you below.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3049043320]Italian Translation[/url] by Rahl81
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3028548927]Russian translation[/url] by knon20
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131808222]Chinese translation[/url] by 兽耳娘是好文明
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3108330591]Chinese translation[/url] by 卡尔文迪斯梅特
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2643924196]Japanese translation[/url] by Rio_Mizuhoshi


[h1]Credits[/h1]
Big thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/oldent/myworkshopfiles/?appid=281990]OldEnt[/url] for getting this updated to 3.1.2!

title: Unique Ascension Perks
description:
[h1]⚠️ [b]This Mod just works for the ([b]3.14[/b] [i]'Circinus'[/i]) version![/b] ⚠️[/h1][HR]
[h2][b]◿ I[/b]NTRODUCTION[/h2]
Hello guys, are you looking for more gameplay and unique features not seen anywhere else?
Do you want more Ascension Perks granting you amazing stuff instead of only some annoying modifiers? Then you’ve come to the right place because that’s all we do!

[h1][b]◿ F[/b]EATURES[/h1]
This mod brings you a large amount of new Ascension Perks as well as some Ascension Paths for you to discover. [h1][b]◿ R[/b]ECOMMENDED[/h1]

• If you have problems with extra district view you can use [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url] (or UI Overhaul 1080p & 1440p or [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/1587178040]Bigger Planet View[/url])
• [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2603967089]Lots of Traditions - PT, EST, and ST[/url]
• [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2807759164]The Merger of Rules[/url] (load order should rather be below)

[img]//i.imgur.com/4FuU1Y4.png[/img]

[h1][b]◿ C[/b]OMPATIBILITY[/h1]
✅ Guilli’s Planet Modifiers
✅ Real Space
✅ Planetary Diversity
✅ Most Ascension and Tradition Mods like:
⠀✅ !!!Traditional Trees
⠀✅ [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/946222466]Expanded Stellaris Traditions[/url] (recommended)
⠀✅ [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/1311725711]Plentiful Traditions[/url] (recommended)
⠀✅ Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks
⠀✅ Ascendant Stars
⠀✅ Forerunner
✅ Intended all Mods supported by The Merger of Rules (e.g. problems Branch Offices)
⠀✅ ACOT, ZOFE, GIGA, Ethics and Civics Classic
✅ Empires Expanded (fixed conflict AP "Economical Mastery")
✅ Stellar Manipulation Rewrite/Revival - Needs Sartek Merger mod
• For more you can look at [url=//steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/2821711162]Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger[/url]
• Should be savegame compatible (> 3.9)

[img]//i.imgur.com/4FuU1Y4.png[/img]

[h3][b]◿ L[/b]OCALIZATION[/h3]
I apologize in advance for my English, so if you guys find any mistakes, just tell me and I will fix it as soon as possible.
• Fallback (English) to all standard languages
• 🇬🇧 EN thanks to [url=//steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199110417882]Epimus[/url] for improvement
• 🇯🇵 JP thanks to [url=//steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198099426560]Bee634[/url]
• 🇷🇺 RU thanks to [url=////steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/3039584868]Hann[/url] - (previous [url=//steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198060299040]Dexter Morgan[/url])
• 🇨🇳 CN by [url=//steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198417136420]零[/url] (former [url=//steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/2911390086]五萌汉化机翻版[/url]/[url=//steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/2131014154]Doves Chinese Localization[/url])
• 🇮🇹 IT by [url=//steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/2902049163]Rahl81[/url]

[h3][b]◿ T[/b][i]o-Do[/i][/h3]
• Finishing rework Sector Z-749?
• Wheel of Fortune rework (add "Treasure Khan-Lord")?
• Expansion of Infinity split perk!? (leave building slots 35)
• Combine most edict events and popup decisions into a "main menu"
• Idea new AP "Friends in Highest Places" (by Dominicius)
• Idea new AP "Galactic Capital" (by Dominicius)

[img]//i.imgur.com/ydr2SQm.png[/img][h3]◿ [b]C[/b]REDIT[/h3]
• ©[b]DrBLOOD95[/b] creating this mod
• FirePrince & KIRINAS maintaining >3.2.
• Epimus for English improvement
• All bug & balance reporters (especially KIRINAS)
• Bee634 for localization patch and JP localization
• Joakim.Westergaard (compatibility updates 3.6)
• Soilborn for detailed job/district desc (3.7)

title: 明日方舟船模Arknights Shipset
description:
本mod为明日方舟mod：“明日方舟：不远的未来Arknights:Near Future”中的船模部分。

已经集成进主mod中，没有必要再开这个，如果还想要同时开启的话一定要将船模mod置于主mod上方！！！
[img]https://files.seeusercontent.com/2026/02/17/E5rf/Shipset01Tips.png[/img]

已根据模型配好了相应的尾焰粒子效果~

强烈推荐与3D Fleet Formation一起使用！


This shipset is loaded in Arknights mod:"Arknights:Near Future".

Already loaded in the main mod, there's no need to use this one. If you still want to use them at the same time, please put the shipset mod ABOVE the main mod!!!!!!!

Unique exhaust particles added~

Recommend using with 3D Fleet Formation, or the impression will be really awful.


TO DO:
*其他巨构不打算做 No other megastructures' models.
*NSC大概不会有了吧...Sadly there's maybe no NSC patch...

2026.2.17UPDATE
适配最新版本

2022.2.12UPDATE
1.优化点位、尺寸 
Optimized weapon position and scale.
2.新增殖民船动画、居住站、舰载机 
Newly added animated colonizer/habitat/carrier craft
3.修复【common】文件夹中的问题，现在可以在预设名字中找到特有舰船名预设
Fixed problems in the folder[common], and now you can use unique default ship names.

2022.6.9UPDATE
修复了可能出现的逗号名字
Fixed occurance of the name ",".

Enjoy it.

顺便介绍一下原作者CG Pitbull，这位是十分厉害的科幻艺术家，我在Turbosquid上买了他的模型并做成了这套船模，如果大家也有相关需求可以去看看~购买即可商用，允许修改。

Here's the author of these models, CG Pitbull, a really skilled sci-fi artist.
I purchased his models on Turbosquid and turned them into this shipset. If you have some needs, you can visit his pages.Can be commercially used after your purchase and modifications allowed.

title: Extra Ship Components NEXT
description:
[h1][b]Extra Ship Components: NEXT[/b][/h1]

[b][u]WARNING[/u][/b]: this mod is NOT compatible with existing [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1885775216][b]ESC 3.0[/b][/url] saves. You need to start a new game.

[b]Other mod versions[/b]:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806337339]3.3[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2864364422]3.4[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2946654222]3.6[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2973696551]3.7[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3084321158]3.9[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3168979527]3.10[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3239988003]3.11[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3475933021]3.14[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3572919548]4.0[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3686393320]4.2[/url] -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3745453390]4.3[/url]

"[b]Extra Ship Components[/b]" aims to provide an extended and expanded technology tree, adding advanced weapons, shields and armor. Highlights include:
- Psionic weapons.
- Nanite weapons and armors.
- Gravitic weapons.
- Biological weapons and armors.
- Crystalline weapons.
- Leviathan rewards.
- Medium to Titanic autocannons.
- Advanced weapons derived from space creatures.
- And much, much more...

[b]GitHub[/b]: [url=https://github.com/Solovyev-Pavel/nh_esc_next]ESC NEXT git repository[/url]
[b]Images[/b]: [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/14285331925503727131/29AE1B196607A152008FB3D185232AFACAD5E0DD/][u]  1  [/u][/url] - [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/14772868168343864651/E0141195528AC5811086B67D1DAEBFAAF3E3BF4C/][u]  2  [/u][/url] - [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18317446562631372129/4A3A0AB27A0FD8EE4DB547C1161DDB29658167D1/][u]  3  [/u][/url] - [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/12872294867834119032/9D2F52DAE6539B6D70993A1C4C8E9245C36BFE74/][u]  4  [/u][/url] - [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9562297264644597358/DAD9563BF15A1780E5AB85FB531A77FDCE9B6950/][u]  5  [/u][/url]

[h1][b]In-built Compatibility[/b][/h1]

* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458024521][b]Dynamic Mod Menu[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2288335512][b]Ancient Cache of Technologies: Extra Defines and Changes[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=683230077][b]New Ship Classes 3[/b][/url]. This mod must be loaded before NSC3
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=914872677][b]Space Combat Expanded[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1377634390][b]Core Game Mechanics: Debris[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1365485813][b]Core Game Mechanics: Buildings[/b][/url]
* [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1317022177][b]The Zenith of Fallen Empires 2.0[/b][/url] (hopefully)
* [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1327186200][b]UltraJuggernaut[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=725596168][b]Realsitic Ships[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1613766846][b]At War: Starbase Improvements[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1893193650][b]Ancient Dreadnought and Improved Titan 2.5[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1359700418][b]!Expanded Starbases[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2028826064][b]A Deadly Tempest[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1715190550][b]Unofficial Hive DLC: Forgotten Queens[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2441507863][b]Machines & Robot Expansion[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2425550468][b]Wiirlak Additional Civics and Origins[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2626196020][b]Defense Fortress[/b][/url] ( needs test )

[h1][b]Addons[/b][/h1]

* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2653789292][b]ESC NEXT: Overwrites: Component Progression[/b][/url] - allows for smooth upgrading progression from the most basic vanilla components to their ultimate forms in ESC NEXT.
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2653699311][b]ESC NEXT: Overwrites: Global Ship Designs[/b][/url] - upgrades Fallen Empire ships, Curator stations, Crises ships and some Leviathans to utilize new ESC NEXT components.
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2663957444][b]ESC NEXT: Overwrites: Special Weapon Types Patch[/b][/url] - updates turret definitions with assignment of entities for biological, nanite and psionic weapons and removes no-longer-needed secondary weapon types from those weapons (which were used to avoid issues with turrets).
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2664848729][b]ESC NEXT: Overwrites: 6x System Scale[/b][/url] - reduces ranges of weapons by the factor of 6. [b][u]Use this addon only if you play with system scaling mods[/u][/b].

[h1][b]Language Patches[/b][/h1]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681735365][b]Russian 1[/b][/url] | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810284852][b]Russian 2[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2913770291][b]German[/b][/url]
* [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177][b]French[/b][/url]

title: Technology Tree (for Chinese Language)
description:
为原版拥有后置科技的科技显示它的科技树，稀有科技和危险科技分别用紫色和红色标出。
[b]本mod可选择游戏语言为英语或中文启动，游戏中的科技树会显示为中文。[/b]
[b]下面的全语言通用版mod同样有中文科技树，但不支持选择游戏语言英语来启动。[/b]
[b]for English, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean : [/b][url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1234426616]Technology Tree[/url]

[b]支持铁人成就。[/b]
[b]为了更好的阅读体验，你可能需要配合该mod使用:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1313533917]更宽的提示框[/url]
[b]当前支持版本：3.14[/b]
请注意当前版本似乎变成了手动控制mod加载顺序，这个mod应该控制在汉化mod之后加载，因为它需要在汉化的基础上覆盖科技文本。
Steam的缓存机制与Stellaris新启动器的毛病有时会导致旧版mod不会自动更新，如果你发现文件修改日期一直是旧的，请尝试取消订阅，删除mod相关文件后再重新订阅。

[h1]如何读[/h1]
[b]以【自我认知逻辑】为例[/b]
[code]
  |--自主殖民船 [还需 AI殖民船(殖民地制造无人机)] [计算技术]
  |--正电子AI [计算技术]
  |  |--合成人 [还需 智能人,银河管理] [狂热, 灵光一闪, 策展人, 工业]
  |  |  |--合成人人格矩阵 [工业>3]
  |  |  |--替换电路 [还需 交叉模块标准化] [狂热, 灵光一闪, 策展人, 工业]
  |  |--知性战斗模拟 [还需 拓展战斗算法] [计算技术, 策展人, 狂热, 计算技术>2]
  |--拓展战斗算法 [还需 特战电脑] [计算技术]
     |--知性战斗模拟 [还需正电子AI] [计算技术, 策展人, 狂热, 计算技术>2]
[/code]
[list]
[*]研究【自我认知逻辑】是解锁【自主殖民船】【正电子AI】【拓展战斗算法】三项科技的必要条件，其中【自主殖民船】和【拓展战斗算法】还各自需要研究其他科技后才可能出现。
[*]由科技名后面的图标可以知道【知性战斗模拟】是物理科技，指派满足【计算技术、策展人、狂热、计算技术且大于2级】这四种条件任何一种的科学家来研究物理科技，将提高【知性战斗模拟】出现的概率。提高的概率从左到右递减，因此你应该先满足列表中最左侧的特质或者等级要求。同时也最好尽可能满足多项要求，因为提高的概率有时可以叠加。
[*]科技树中有两个【知性战斗模拟】，这不代表有两个同名科技，而是指【知性战斗模拟】有【正电子AI】和【拓展战斗算法】两项前置科技。
[*]唯一的例外是【机械模板系统】，它是整个游戏中唯一的有两个名字完全相同而只有描述不同的科技名。
[/list]
[h1]注意[/h1]
[list]
[*]科技描述后的括号中给出了该科技的等级，要想刷出2级及以上科技，你必须保证已经研究过前一等级的6项科技，比如想刷出2级科技，你需要保证已经研究过6项或更多的1级科技。
[*]科技树中每个科技名前面括号中的数字，代表这个科技所属的级别。每个科技后面的图标则指示该科技是属于物理、社会还是工程。
[*]要想刷出某个科技，必须满足1.前一等级科技至少研究6项　2.它的所有前置科技都已研究完成，这两个条件是所有科技都适用的大前提。但科技刷出的概率同时还和已点的传统和飞升、邻国的科技、游戏进行年数等条件有关，例如科研船的"自动探索协议"5年之内出现的概率为0。而这些条件每个科技几乎都不相同。因为屏幕上科技描述位置能显示的字数有限，这些每个科技各不相同的具体条件就没有写上去。
[*]一些灵能科技并不能根据显示的科技树来解锁，科技定义文件中虽然仍将"预判接口"设置为"灵能跃迁引擎"的前置科技，但这两项科技现在只能通过虚境获得。
[*]科技树中所有的特质名和科技名都是变量的引用，而不是硬编码的字符串，它显示的内容随着tech_robomodding等变量的改变而变化。因此如果你的mod中修改了tech_robomodding等科技名或特质名的翻译，科技树中会采用修改后的科技名和特质名。
[/list]

title: Elegant Chinese Random Names & Localisation Fix
description:
A Chinese Localisation Mod 

-------------------------------------

[B]最后更新：3.14[/B]

由于在新版本下蠢户已经修正了大多数的汉化问题，因此撤销了大部分对原版格式的修改，仅修正少部分词组

新增了一个预设名称包 - 人类（中华）； 既复古又未来的中国风预设名称包。

已经完成对新版本的重制与调整适应，模组正常运作，但是否还有隐藏问题仍旧需要游戏体验去测试。

暂时未发现与新版本的兼容性问题。

由于更改随机名称与添加名称包也会变更校验码，所以此模组会导致校验码的改变。

-

在被无厘头的国家与派系等名称困扰吗？ 觉得星系名字看着太蠢太怪吗？ 这个可以帮助你。

[b]模组简介与特征:[/b]

- 此随机名称包仿照中国古代的星宿命名格式来赋予所有恒星系美观大气的架空名称，总数量十分庞大，约为18000+.

- 富有诗意的星云命名，以及重新书写和编排的黑洞名称。

- 国家名称与派系的汉化修复，拥有更合理的词组和有序美观的排列。

- 由于官方在3.5已经修复了诸多汉化问题，遂移除了相关的修改。

- 修正了其它较小的文本或汉化问题。

- 由于作者停更，不再建议搭配贴吧汉化字体使用，在新版本与UI Overhaul一同使用会导致BUG.
推荐 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2845435203 
<旗黑标准字号中文字体>

- 在订阅安装此模组后，你不再需要订阅安装其它的随机名称与汉化修复模组。

替换的原文件：00_random_names
其它文件出于模组兼容性考虑不再直接替换，但是这也造成了名称被混用的问题，无法解决。

[B]关于兼容性[/B]
加载顺序优先度：无特定
如若出现冲突（例如更多政体与思潮）导致国家名称不显示，将此模组在模组列表顺序中向上调整到冲突模组之上即可，但这样导致模组的此部分失效，会被替换为目标模组的文件内设置。



依稀记得以前有以中国传统星宿来命名恒星系的名称包，但不知何时消失后便再也找不到了。
衍生于<真实随机中文名称包>，早先由于不太满意其中的部分随机名称，因此自己着手修改。结果最终的修改体积十分巨大，基本等于完全重写。
而后与更好的汉化修复编辑整合后完成此模组，也在此分享给同样喜爱美观随机名称的各位。
请别忘记点个赞让更多人看到喔。


标签：中文，汉化，汉化修复，随机名称包，Chinese Random Name

以上，祝你平安

由于更改随机名称与添加名称包也会变更校验码，所以此模组会导致校验码的改变。

-

在被无厘头的国家与派系等名称困扰吗？ 觉得星系名字看着太蠢太怪吗？ 这个可以帮助你。

模组简介与特征:

- 此随机名称包仿照中国古代的星宿命名格式来赋予所有恒星系美观大气的架空名称，总数量十分庞大，约为18000+.

- 富有诗意的星云命名，以及重新书写和编排的黑洞名称。

- 国家名称与派系的汉化修复，拥有更合理的词组和有序美观的排列。

- 由于官方在3.5已经修复了诸多汉化问题，遂移除了相关的修改。

- 修正了其它较小的文本或汉化问题。

- 由于作者停更，不再建议搭配贴吧汉化字体使用，在新版本与UI Overhaul一同使用会导致BUG.
推荐 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2845435203 
<旗黑标准字号中文字体>

- 在订阅安装此模组后，你不再需要订阅安装其它的随机名称与汉化修复模组。

替换的原文件：00_random_names
其它文件出于模组兼容性考虑不再直接替换，但是这也造成了名称被混用的问题，无法解决。

关于兼容性
加载顺序优先度：无特定
如若出现冲突（例如更多政体与思潮）导致国家名称不显示，将此模组在模组列表顺序中向上调整到冲突模组之上即可，但这样导致模组的此部分失效，会被替换为目标模组的文件内设置。



依稀记得以前有以中国传统星宿来命名恒星系的名称包，但不知何时消失后便再也找不到了。
衍生于<真实随机中文名称包>，早先由于不太满意其中的部分随机名称，因此自己着手修改。结果最终的修改体积十分巨大，基本等于完全重写。
而后与更好的汉化修复编辑整合后完成此模组，也在此分享给同样喜爱美观随机名称的各位。
请别忘记点个赞让更多人看到喔。


标签：中文，汉化，汉化修复，随机名称包，Chinese Random Name

以上，祝你平安

title: More Origins Mod
description:
This mod adds multiple new origins to the game, most of which are once per galaxy and may appear in randomly generated ai empires if all conditions are met.

[h1]List of content:[/h1]
[quote][quote]by Malthus:
[b]A House Divided[/b]
You start out with your two starting colony targets already colonized by your species. The bad news is these colonies seceded and think themselves better off on their own. Your relations can be described as being in a cold war state. This scenario is meant to offer early game conflict, though if you are lucky with your spawn location and play your cards right, a diplomatic solution may be possible as well. Same as for the federation starts this origin has the drawback of lacking exploration bonusses as you directly compete for anomalies with your neighbors right from the start.

[b]Severance[/b]
You start with your standard homeworld and a poorly developed colony somewhere in the galaxy connected by an unstable wormhole. You do have a permanent techoption to research wormhole travel right from the start in order to reconnect your people. This scenario puts you at a military disadvantage as long as you cannot use the wormhole but at the same time it provides you with more exploration opportunities.

[b]Exiles[/b]
You start out with a rather standard homeworld, no advantages or disadvantages so far. What makes this origin radically different from the other two is the event chain which lets you uncover the mystery of your heritage. It is NOT a branching story, so I do not want to spoil it here by telling it already.

[b]Divine Guidance[/b]
You start with an immortal ruler. A charismatic leader with an intellect rivaling that of the greatest minds, chosen by the divine (Chosen One, Charismatic, Erudite). If he or she - or it (for those strange aliens out there) - dies, however, your people will surely suffer. But life always finds a way - especially when you have some smart scientists around...

[b]Overcrowded[/b]
You start the game with 65 Pops + additional districts and buildings to get them to work, but don't get too excited, there is a severe drawback. The world is overcrowded and near collapse and has a modifier that reflects this. You can fix this, but you will have to heavily invest into it (Arcology Project).[/quote]

[quote]by yrbmed:
[b]Climate Catastrophy[/b]
You start on a world not fitting your species' climate preference anymore, but your people have learned to adapt an built giant domed structures to preserve a livable habitat for themselves. This technological wonder might prove useful during the colonisation of other planets.

[b]Wormhole Junction[/b]
Your civilization has discovered a strange anomaly within its home system long before discovering the hyperlance network. This anomaly is a semi stable wormhole with varying exits but a stable position in your system. Given time an research multiple exits may be made permanent and thus usable for travel through them.[/quote][/quote]

Added russian translation thanks to petrovytsh
French Translation submod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177

For Launcher issues:
Try renaming your Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris folder and let the launcher create a new one at statup. Then see if the clean folder lets you start the mod normally. If that works, take over your custom empire file and savegames.

If nothing else helps you can download the latest version here: https://github.com/Elimdur/MoreOriginsMod/releases
To make it work you'll have to create a local mod using your launcher first and put the files in there.

If you are a modder, who wants to join this project and add your own origins or create new ones based on the suggestions, contact me here or via discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/bHVez2C][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

title: Basic Ordinary Origins
description:
[h1]Current Version 3.4 (Released 6/15/26, Compatible with 4.4)[/h1]

[h2]Ironman Compatible, but NOT Achievement Compatible[/h2]

[h1][B][url=https://discord.gg/9KuyXv2uZA]Discord Server for my mods[/url]
[url=https://cybrxkhansmods.godaddysites.com/]Official Website for my mods[/url][/B][/h1]

Legacy Versions:
4.3 - https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/u2boomh171gtzs57oiqch/Basic-Ordinary-Origins-v.3.3.b-for-4.3.zip?rlkey=m350izajypx5buk7jjpc2rve9&dl=0

Basic Ordinary Origins adds in several new origins that are just that - basic and ordinary. They are simple origins meant to provide alternative "default" origins to Prosperous Unification, with starting bonuses that are similarly mundane and not drastic. They won’t change gameplay significantly, but will hopefully add flavor and variety to your games so not every nation starts with the “Prosperous Unification” origin. Though this isn’t meant to be perfectly balanced, keeping in line with the vanilla origins' lack of balance, none will ideally be overpowered.

[B]This mod is compatible with virtually everything. It is ironman compatible, but NOT achievement compatible, as it changes your checksum.[/B]

[h1]Latest Update: Version 3.4 (Released 6/15/26)[/h1]

[LIST]
[*]Updated to 4.4
[/LIST]


[h1]My Other Mods[/h1]

[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=682691478]Cybrxkhan’s Assortment of Namelists for Stellaris[/url][/b]: Thousands of new names for leaders, spaceships, stars, and more! Fantasy, real-world inspired, and many others.
[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701432146]More AI Personalities[/url][/b]: A mod that introduces tons of new AI personalities, adding more variety to the game.
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2621564981]No Ethics Spawn Bias[/url][/b]: With this mini-mod, ethics of randomly generated AI empires are more evenly weighted to appear, so there’s less of a chance you’ll be surrounded by hostile empires as in vanilla.


[h1]List of New Origins[/h1]

There are currently twenty new origins. Please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2027051983/1870623560004101623/][B]this thread[/B][/url] for more detailed information about them.

[LIST]
[*]Antediluvian Knowledge
[*]Chosen Revolutionary
[*]Chosen Royal
[*]Clean Energy
[*]Former Scavengers
[*]Global Wars
[*]Great Khanate
[*]Legendary Friendship
[*]Lost Continent
[*]Mysterious Bonds
[*]One with Nature
[*]Post-Post-Apocalyptic
[*]Silk Road
[*]Slow Evolution
[*]Steampunk
[*]Survival of the Fittest
[*]The Gate
[*]Trekkers of the Stars
[*]War to End All Wars
[/LIST]

[h1]Translations[/h1]

Several translations are available in other languages, mostly as submods. Please note some of these may not be up to date with the latest version of the mod.

[LIST]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2911390086]Chinese[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=2902370746]Italian[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2583379879]Japanese[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=2810284852]Russian[/url]
[*]Spanish - included by default
[/LIST]

[h1]Credits[/h1]

Thank you to AGold for Spanish localization.

title: [Deprecated] The Zenith of Fallen Empires 3.0
description:
[h1]The Zenith of Fallen Empires 4.0 is now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2958421797]LIVE[/url][/h1]








[i]They were promising once. The big-eyed, fluffy primitives that pleased our ancestors were uplifted, in hopes they would contribute to galactic community that we built. But all things must end. Our ancestors were deceived. For centuries, they spied on us, stole from us. Our technologies, our secrets, taken with scant regard for the elders who brought those advances to our society. And now they proclaim themselves an Ascended Empire, one that will span millennia using our technologies to serve their twisted ideals. Wasting no time, they quickly converted half the galaxy to their cause. How long they have conspired and waited for this moment. As the titan foundries roar to life, and our once dormant shipyards rumble, our people unite once more against the monsters we created. The prophets foresaw the traitors’ demise – let us hope that they were right.[/i]


The Zenith of Fallen Empires returns with its long-awaited third iteration of the popular mod series. Featuring a brand-new ascension mechanic, The Zenith of Fallen Empires retraces the steps of the fallen, allowing players to rise and eventually become Ascended Empires – Fallen Empires in their prime, where they carve out their own sphere of influence by converting lesser empires to their cause. In this playground of the giants, the future of the galaxy is at stake. Building on the advances made in 2.0, The Zenith of Fallen Empires will continue to deliver the experience through add-on component mods, allowing players the freedom and flexibility to choose and forge their own path in this ultimate sandbox – the story of their civilization’s rise, and fall.

The Zenith of Fallen Empires 4.0 is now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2958421797]LIVE








They were promising once. The big-eyed, fluffy primitives that pleased our ancestors were uplifted, in hopes they would contribute to galactic community that we built. But all things must end. Our ancestors were deceived. For centuries, they spied on us, stole from us. Our technologies, our secrets, taken with scant regard for the elders who brought those advances to our society. And now they proclaim themselves an Ascended Empire, one that will span millennia using our technologies to serve their twisted ideals. Wasting no time, they quickly converted half the galaxy to their cause. How long they have conspired and waited for this moment. As the titan foundries roar to life, and our once dormant shipyards rumble, our people unite once more against the monsters we created. The prophets foresaw the traitors’ demise – let us hope that they were right.

title: Battle Debris - Starship Graveyards
description:
With this mod, ships destroyed in battle will (usually) leave debris behind. This is a purely visual change, meant to give large space battles and their aftermath a little more weight.

This may lag your game a bit in systems with large debris fields, but the debris gradually disappears over the years. There is a starbase building that can cause it to decay faster, so people with weaker PCs will be able to clean the stuff up to improve performance, and a building that prevents debris from decaying at all if you want to preserve it as a war memorial. I don't plan to expand the mod beyond that; this will remain a graphics mod in all other ways.

If you want to remove the starbase buildings, for whatever reason, go into steamapps/workshop/content/281990/1353547443/mzilli_battle_debris/common and delete the starbase_buildings folder.

Compatible with all other mods. German translations provided by @BlackSun.

title: APSR: Anomalies, Planetary and Space Resources
description:
Does the galaxy seem boring and monotonous?
Are the planets different from each other?
Do you want variety?
[h1]Then you found what you need![/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MUb3S6e.png[/img]
This mod adds a lot of unique for the whole galaxy and very unusual resources, exciting quest chains, interesting events. From the legacy of a galaxy-spanning empire to the infinite depths of a mine. And although it is not difficult to get such a resource, retaining it becomes a real test. Not everyone will like a neighbor who has a unique weapon or an incredible power plant.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eu9GTcM.png[/img]
Up to 24 special planets can appear in the galaxy, each of which has a planetary feature that exists in a single copy. Possession of it can greatly affect the development of the empire.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yvghePU.png[/img]
In general terms, this mod can be represented as follows:
[olist]
	[*]found
	[*]colonized (or took away from a neighbor)
	[*]built a special building
	[*]digged up a special relic
	[*]won in... However, this is still in the plans...
[/olist]

title: Guilli's Ship Components (no longer updated)
description:
Hello everyone,

I've sadly decided I'm no longer going to support this particular mod. The new archo weapons really mess with balance and I just don't have the energy or time to flesh those out as well as keep the other ones up to date with the many game changes. Sadly the script code for components is quite time intensive to work on and I'd like to use the little time I have these days to focus on my planet modifier mod.  

If anyone wants to take over this mod, feel free. Keep in mind I will most likely recycle the utility components (localisation and art) into my planet modifier mod as rare rewards. 

Thank you for understanding,
-Guilli

-----------------------------
--------------------------
----------------------
------------------



[h1]100+ new ship components & weapons with matching technologies, 8 new ship sections with aux slots, new advanced science ship [/h1]
Compatible with version 3.7+, and all DLC


----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]NSC Compatibility: [/h1]
No longer compatible. I cannot keep up with their development speed and the size of their mod. Sorry! Feel free to make a patch.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------


This mod adds a lot of new ship modules as well as extra levels of existing ship modules and weapons. This mod is save game compatible. 


[h1]The following have been added:[/h1]

[b]Technologies[/b]
These are new techs to help speed up the component research.
[list]
[*] 3 new techs to help speed up Physics research.
[*] 3 new techs to help speed up Engineering research. 
[/List]

[b]Ship Modules[/b]
[list]
[*] Armoured Thrusters 1-4
[*] Psionic Thrusters 1-4
[*] Crystallis Ship Sensors 6-10
[/List]

[b]Reactor Slot[/b]
[list]
[*] Crystallis Reactors VI - X
[/List]

[b]Utility Modules[/b]
[list]
[*] Crystal Plating II - V
[*] Crystal Armor VI - X
[*] Phase-Shields VI - X (hive mind) 
[*] Force-Fields VI - X (Not materialists, not hivemind)
[*] Psionic Barriers VI - X (psionics) 
[*] Adaptive Shields VI - X (Materialists) 
[/List]


[b]Auxiliary Modules[/b]
[list]
[*] Crystal Targeting Matrix I - V 
[*] Crystal Tissue I - V  
[*] Ship Hangar Bays 1-5 
[*] Shield Capacitors II - III 
[/List]

[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new Lasers: Positron and Anti-Matter
[*] 2 new Plasma cannons: Phased-Plasma and Chrono-Plasma
[*] 2 new Energy Lances: Tetryon and Polaron
[*] 2 new Disruptors: Resonant and Muon
[*] 2 new Disintegrators: Improved and Matter-Energy
[*] 2 new Arc Emitters: Vexed and Concerted
[*] 2 new Missiles: Isokinetic and Chroniton
[*] 2 new Swarm Missiles: Typhoon and Hurricane
[*] 2 new Torpedoes: Cobalt and Tricobalt
[*] 2 new Energy Torpedoes: Anti-Proton and Quantum
[*] 2 new Railguns: Tri-Gaus and XV-88
[*] 2 new Kinetic Guns: Kinetic Cannon and Kinetic Howitzer
[*] 2 new Autocannons: Thunder and Thor
[*] 2 new Mass Accelerators: Ultra Cannon and Omega Cannon
[*] 2 new Point Defense: Mercy and Emperor
[*] 2 new Flak: Flak Array and Flak Barrier
[*] 2 new Strike Craft Tiers (final tier is dimensional unlock after salvaging/unlocking unbidden dimensional weaponry tech)
[/List]

[h1]Techs[/h1]
All modules have their own technologies. Some are rare. Tier 6 to Tier 10 modules come after their vanilla variants and techs, so these are very much late game technologies. 
For those with Utopia DLC: The final tier weapon technologies have a low spawn chance unless you build the science nexus! 
For those without Utopia DLC: the final tier weapon technologies will show up normally.
The science nexus increases the chance advanced component & weapons technologies show up by 500%

	
[h1]Ship Power Stations for other mods.?[/h1]
Feel free to make a compatibility patch. I sadly don't have the time. 

[h1]For other modders:[/h1]
All my techs are prefixed with [b]tech_c_techname[/b]
All my other files are prefixed with [b]C_modulename/componant[/b]

title: (((-NSC3 Season 1-))) Chinese Translation
description:
针对NSC3进行中文翻译的MOD，方便大家享受NSC3，本mod仅有文本，因此如果有文字、叙述缺失以外的问题的话请确认NSC3 mod与其他mod是否有发生冲突，如果汉化失败的话请把这个MOD放在NSC3的MOD后面

NSC2是一个增加船舰种类的mod，其中包括配套的恒星基地扩展、少量的武器以及大量的组件，增加舰队的变化性

由于本翻译发布时贴吧翻译尚未发布，因此某些名词翻译可能有所差异，如有差异欢迎提出

如果出现了只有局部汉化状况的话，请到MOD列表把这个MOD放到NSC MOD后面去

有一些玩法或使用上上的问题可以参考游戏内的FAQ，我全部都翻译了应该看得懂

[h1][b]mod推廣區[/b][/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1324813584]更多中文汉化[/url]
汉化了大量mod，工作坊上受欢迎的mod几乎都在其汉化清单中

[h1]Bug回报方式[/h1]
由于作者现在没那么多时间玩群星了，所以很难注意到翻译缺失这种BUG
如果有出现的话麻烦在底下留言并提供字串遗漏对应的代码，我会尽快处理

如果碰到文本只有代码的状况下
请回报对应的代码，如：balanced_focus_name, edict_nsc_flagship_repair_possible_check_tooltip等
请不要跟我说某某介面的什么东西
在文本里面我是没办法直接看出文本对应介面的
我也没玩群星很久了，根本搞不清楚现在的群星怎么玩

title: Stellaris 101: How to Read
description:
[h1][b]This mod does nothing, no contents, don't subscribe![/b][/h1]




[h1]If you are wondering why you are here, Congrats! That means you passed 'The Read Test'![/h1]

You now hold the power of reading the mod description, which makes you think twice before comment - way better than most steam users whose comments are 'update?', 'wryyyyy mod not workeeee', 'kthxbye', and so on.

[h1][b]Try to do these as well:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][h1]If the mod asks you use required mod to function, you should follow. Unless you know how that works.[/h1]

[*]If you're in a need of finding the collection mods in the collection mods, check out the collection mods. 

[*]Check out the mod's update time, and its changelog.

[*]Don't forget the existence of Discussion if there's a one in the mod you are using or reading.

[*]If there's a Discord link to [b]'Stellaris Modding Den'[/b] in mod description, you can get more helpful hands in there. A place of modders.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/4Z8X68t.png[/img]
This is a link to [b]'[REDACTED]'[/b], what? what do you mean it's not clickable? :P
Use the mighty Internet Explorer 6 to find the link!

[/list]

Good luck, and Have fun with your space conquest!

title: (-United Sci-Fi Races-)
description:
This mod is an effort to combine sci-fi related races in one place. The plan is to create, combine, improve and revive portraits from all available science fiction mods specifically the ones that are no longer updated by their creators. It is an independent mod with focus mainly on portraits. Now there are 220+ races (120+ animated) and increasing. This mod as most other mods is not compatible with achievements.

[h1] Content [/h1]
Current, but not final Sci-Fi sections and animated portraits are listed below: 
•	Babylon 5 – 1 animated (narn); 
•	Mass Effect – about half animated (from EDI, prothean to geth, kett)
•	Star Wars – about half animated (mirialan, zabrak, twi’lek, togruta, sith, chiss, sullustan, jawa, rodian, neimodians, duros)
•	Star Trek – all races animated;
•	Miscellaneous races – na'vi from Avatar, xenomorph, terminator, 2 Star Gate races and 3 PlanetSide factions animated, protoss;
•	Special Stellaris races – all (contingency, unbidden, robots, swarm) races animated;
•	Halo – Cortana, UNCS, prehuman, covenant races;
•	Doctor Who – all races static;
•	Warhammer 40k – all races static;
•	XCOM – all races static.
•	Fantasy - all races animated.

There are also included name lists and planets/systems, but other modifications (prescr. empires, race traits, overhauls, predefinitions) are NOT included as my idea is to make it as universal as possible. If you need additional traits, you can get them from this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=850721710] awesome mod [/url] inspired by various sci-fi themes.

[h1] Random spawning and type of races [/h1]
Random spawning is set to No, so You can decide what races are included in your game. See links to patches:
•	[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=858366182] Activates randomisation for all races[/url]; 
•	[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=876893105] Activates randomisation ONLY for animated races (static ones are hidden) [/url].

Current mod adds races in sections by default considered as for organic races by game, but if you want to play a custom race from this pack as robotic empire (for example, borg, geth and etc.,) subscribe following patch mod [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=1142647596] United Sci-Fi races: Robots.[/url]

[h1] Conflicting mods [/h1]
Mass Effect Theme Pack – overwrites Mass Effect races;

[h1] Also:[/h1]
Please see also what content of other mods were used for this mod in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/814332008/1842367319511271273] specific discussion thread[/url]. You may also suggest races from outdated mods or new race you have been looking for. No promises, but I consider each suggestion and appreciate your feedback. If You like it, please rate it :).

Naturally I cannot cover all Sci-Fi races/factions, but I will do as much possible from my side to create, animate and improve current mod content that we all could enjoy this awesome game mixed with other sci-fi themes.

[h1] Please check out my mods:[/h1]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814332008] United Sci-Fi races (200+ races) [/url] 
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=850721710] United Traits (70+ traits) [/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=873063455] Extended Vanilla Clothes (1100+ clothes)[/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1142647596] United Sci-Fi: Robots (includes extended SD portraits) [/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814854383] United Flags (various Sci-Fi and other flag collection)[/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1588415009] United Small Tweaks (minor changes for gameplay)[/url]
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766559290] Better Map - significantly better display of empires in the map.[/url]
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2028840023] Pirates Removed - pirate mechanic disabled.[/url]


[h1] Manuals:[/h1]
•  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/814332008/3182216552771790950/] How to hide race you do not want to see in your game play (relevant for randomising patches)?[/url]


[h1] Change log (after 1.8 game release only):[/h1]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/814332008/1519260397786152801/] The list of previous changes (link).[/url]
• V3.0: Na'vies from Avatar added into Misc category. 3 new name lists for Hives: robotic, swarm, purifiers were also included.
• V3.1: The Contingency 2 portraits were added under Special races. Animated EDI from ME and terminator added. Eve Online 4 factions were added.
• V3.2: Female picture for forerunners and animated Cortana were added into Halo section. 3 additional skins of troopers added for Empire of SW. Animated xenomorph added.
• V3.3: Space Rangers races and Asgard race from SG were added into Misc section.  
• V3.4: Wraiths from SG added; name list for turians from ME fixed and improved.
• V3.5: Hhrud and sisters of battle were added to WH section. All WH pictures were revised.
• V3.6: Silurian added to Doctor Who section. Star Wars section expanded: ortolan, neimodians (animated) and duros (animated) were added.
• V3.7: Animated Sectoid added for X-COM section. Star Wars section updated: animated hutt and wookiee added.
• V3.8: new version of animated sectoid added to X-COM section. Also new section Fantasy added. Two new species added for this section: Skeletor and Golden Devil. Also multiple races from StarFall added.

title: Planetary Diversity - Ascension Worlds
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1]Not Achievement Friendly[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]

This mod is 100% stand-alone and will work without [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url].

[h1]Planetary Infestors (Civic)[/h1]
This civic transforms your empire into a hive that colonizes and infests planets like Gaia Seeders. However, the critical difference is that your planets eventually become Hive Worlds. Your homeworld is a Hive World, and your species has the Hive World preference trait.

[h1]Shroud Worlds (Transcendance)[/h1]
Any empire that completes the Transcendence Tradition Tree can create Shroud Worlds. By selecting a planetary decision, you can Shroud-Phase any planet, habitat, or ringworld, granting significant bonuses to Psionic trait pops and imposing large debuffs on non-Psionic pops. Additionally, you can terraform vanilla Shrouded worlds, automatically converting them into Shroud Worlds.

[h1]Flooded Worlds (Hydrocentric)[/h1]
Any empire that completes the Hydrocentric Ascension Perk can create Flooded Worlds. By selecting a planetary decision, you can flood any planet, habitat, or ringworld, granting bonuses to pops with the Aquatic trait. I have also simplified the decision to Expand Planetary Sea, making it a one-time decision that raises the planet's size by a size of three. Also, if you use the Ocean Paradise Origin, your empire will start with the underwater view. This includes Hive and Machine worlds. 

[h1]Flooded Shroud Worlds (Hydrocentric + Transcendence)[/h1]
Planets can simultaneously feature Flooded World and Shroud World modifiers, resulting in a distinct, purply aquatic habitat ideal for your spiritual fish.

[h1]Wasteland Worlds (Unregulated Industrialism)[/h1]
Empires with an Origin or Civic from the Toxoids DLC can access the Unregulated Industrialism Ascension perk. This perk enables a decision for the nine basic planet types, allowing the conversion of a planet into a Wasteland World. This transformation grants significant industrial bonuses but reduces food production and habitability.

[h1]Lithotrophic Worlds (Lithotrophic Worlds)[/h1]
Lithoid empires can access the Lithotrophic Worlds Ascension perk. This perk enables a decision for any non-urban planet, allowing its conversion into a Lithotrophic World. This transformation grants significant bonuses based on the frequency of the crystals, which can be chosen and changed through a planetary decision.

[h1]Lithotrophic Shroud Worlds (Lithotrophic Worlds + Transcendence)[/h1]
Planets can simultaneously feature Lithotrophic Worlds and Shroud World modifiers, resulting in a distinct, purple lithoid world ideal for your spiritual rocks.

[h1]Necro Worlds (Necro Worlds)[/h1]
Empires with Necroid civics and origins can access the Necro Worlds Ascension perk. This perk enables a decision for any planet, arc, or ringworld, allowing its conversion into a Necro World. The transformation grants significant bonuses and turns the planet into a Tomb World. This includes Hive and Machine worlds. 

[h1]Necro Shroud Worlds (Necro Worlds + Transcendence)[/h1]
Planets can simultaneously feature Necro Worlds and Shroud World modifiers, resulting in purple Necro worlds that are ideal for your spiritual zombies and vampires, gaining both bonuses.

[h1]Planetary Superprojects (Unique Techs)[/h1]
These three unique planetary decisions are unlocked by rare mid-game tech. Each involves transforming the planet to produce only one primary resource type by unlocking that district type and lowering the potential of other districts. Unavailable to empires with the Environmentalist and Agarian Idyllic Civics.
[h2]Core Tap[/h2]
Tap into the planet's very core to meet all your energy needs. Unlimited energy districts.
[h2]Agriworld[/h2]
Cover the surface with fertilizer and farmlands, producing endless crops. Unlimited farming districts.
[h2]Mantle Mine[/h2]
Strip the planet's surface to collect every valuable mineral available. Unlimited mining districts.


[h1]Click this link for the [url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url]. Please go there for FAQs, questions, comments, or bug reports.[/h1]
[h3] I'm no longer allowing comments on this workshop item due to the numerous rude messages and people not reading the mod description. Sorry to anyone who doesn't have access to Discord.[/h3]

title: Ancient Cache of Technologies: Extra Defines and Changes
description:
This ACOT Submod make changes to various defines and vanilla repeatables to make Stellaris fit with ACOT more. It can however be used without ACOT if you so desire.

#Note : Not all changes are listed below, some may be missed, I will add them in as I remember lul.

[b][h1] Gameplay Changes[/h1][/b]
[list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]


[*] Fallen Empire Decadence now increases every year by one but has its capped increased to 500.

[*] Planet regenerates health twice as fast, but takes twice as long to begin healing.

[*] Armies take higher damage from bombardments.

[*] Policy now has only 5 years cooldown period.

[*] Debris lasts twice as long, gives a lot more experiences but only provides 5% progress.

[*] Base Maximum megastructures that can be built increased to 5.

[*] Ships will try to readjust their positions based on their tactics much more often.

[*] High Tracking Ships will target high evasion ships much more often. Low Tracking Ships will try to avoid shooting at evasive ships.

[*] Starbases are much less likely to be targeted if there's defense stations protecting it.

[*] Army Morale Damage is reduced by roughly half.

[*] Morale is only considered low if below 30% (from 50%)

[*] Reduces fleet upgrade time by a lot, but reduces the refund costs for changing components.

[h1]Leaders and Forces[/h1]

[*] Increase Leader Level Cap to 20. (Requires stuff to increase Max Leader Level)

[*] Admirals are twice less likely to die in combat.

[*] Prevents generals from ever dying in ground combat (they are already not that useful, better to just make them not dead, besides they are supposed to strategize and lead, not throwing themselves into harm's way.

[*] Increases experience gains for both leaders, armies and ships.

[*] Improves stats from leader level and ship skill levels.

[*] Command Limit increased to 1000. (Obsolete since vanilla also does this now it seems)

[*] Naval Capacity increased to 99999.

[*] Starting Naval Cap increased to 40, I know you are relatively new to space travel, but come to @*!@ on, only 20 ships? :P

[h1]Repeatables[/h1]

[*] Reduces most non-economic repeatables to be capped at 20.

[*] Realigns some repeatable engineerings to Physics and Society so they don't infest Engineering as much.

[*] Readds Hull repeatable upgrades.

[*] Many previous repeatables that were capped at 5 has been increased to 20.

[*] Fallen Empire will now have repeatables at 20.

[*] Research Pact now increases known tech research speed by 100%.

[/list]

[h1] Graphical Changes[/h1]
[list]

[*] Make fleets scatter more so they don't clump up.

[*] Make missiles spread slightly a bit more so they don't clump up.

[*] Reduces Strike Craft's trail length as they tend to look kinda dumb.
[/list]

[b][h1] Limitations (IMPORTANT)[/h1][/b]
[list]

[*] Fleet Powers can still bug out at extreme lengths (like Stellarborne-tier) but it still works on Phanon (which had above 10m hp)

[/list]


[b][h1] FAQ[/h1][/b]

Q: So why do my fleets suddenly have stupidly low fleetpowers?
A: The new calculations make the game less overzealous with how it calculates hull hp, evasions and weapon damage, which also fixes the issue of it not being able to display a fleetpower above 800k-ish without going into 1. (Ship fleetpower, not fleet total power)

Q: Does it actually make my fleets weaker?
A: No, your ship still have the same stats, but events that calls for fleetpower check will require you to do extra works to reach the vanilla score.

Q: Can I use this without ACOT?
A: Yes

Q: Why cap repetables?
A: To keep things realistic, and to prevent the game from actually overflowing. Just how much can you make the kinetic gun fires faster before it can reaches across galaxies in single second?

Q: This seems to be oddly small for an ACOT submod.
A: Wryyyyyyyyy

Q: Who came up with the numbers and balances, can't be you since we all know Panada sucks at balance.
A: The Panada has consorted with multiple dudes to come up with new calculations. Is it balanced? Possibly? Does it work? Yes. Just be glad I manage to fix the 1 fleetpower problem that has been plaguing this game for aeons.

[b][h1] Compatibility[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Overwrite certain vanilla define stats.

[*] Overwrites 00_static_modifiers.

[*] Overwrites all three repeatable files.
[/list]

[h1]Credits and Special Thanks to[/h1]


- Wymorlon for many useful insights and intense debate whether xenophobes should have gene points.

- Velaroz, because hes the calculator. If shits are broken, blame him lulz.

- Stellaris Modding Den Community, learned many useful stuffs there.

- All supporters. Your sacrifice against the FE will be honored in the New Imperium of Meme.

I have a section on Discord for my mods here
[url=https://discord.gg/XvJANRdq57]ACOT Main Discord Server[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/CMjnnET][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

You can also support me on Patreon  [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=10674702]here [/url].

title: Civilian Trade
description:
[h1] Civilian Trade for update 1.8.*[/h1]

No big feature changes or anything for this update!
*Not been tested with Synthetic Dawn Story pack but I don't anticipate any problems, do let me know if you find any. 

[h1] Features: [/h1] 

> Trade planets (planets with pop members of the prosperity faction) produce an 'aura' that send bonuses to planets within range (based on population size)
	> Foreign planets will receive "Foreign trade" which includes a small does of xenophili attraction.
> Various trade auras depending on planetary edicts

> Trade ships spawned from trade planets that run stops to nearby planets 
	> Trade ships number of stops determined by the size of starting planet
	> Trade ships deposit resources directly to the empire upon arrival, along with a reduction in commodity goods for a shot time 
		> Some planetary edicts can influence theses deposits 
	> If destroyed by enemies they provide a small amount of resources to the empire who killed them.
		
		
----

I think this version will also be a bit better on frame rate since the number of ships will be slightly lower overall in the galaxy, since each empire will vary more and the ships disappear after they are done with their stops. 
There is still a limit on total per empire to keep it from absolutely blowing up.
The trade ships are also regular civilian ships that are part of your empire and appear in the civilian ship outliner. You can direct them a tiny bit but they will instantly go back on course.

With the way it is set up currently you don't have to do anything, it all runs in the background basically. Decisions you make will affect them but there is no real direct control you put on them.
This also means that it works perfectly with the AI.

[h1] Hopes and plans for the future:[/h1] 

> A separate civilian trader faction.
	> there are some specific things I'd like a trader faction to want that don't fit perfectly with the prosperity faction.
	> Having the happiness of the faction effect trade ships/bonuses
> Some connection to the unity system
> War Demands
> Events



[h1] Localization: [/h1] 
All of these are just English for the moment. Since so much changed basically all the text has changed and I couldn't keep any of the great translations you guys gave me.
There isn't a lot of text this time around so translating shouldn't be too hard. If you want to help I'll post the localization file in a discussion and you can just post it there.

German: English
French: English
Russian: Complete
Brazilian: English
Polish: English

Important for removing the mod! 

Pause the game.
Open the console " ` " 
type in " event civtrade.66 "
Hit enter and all the trade ships should disappear. Then just save a reload. 

[h1] Compatibility: [/h1] 

This mod should be compatible with most every mod out there at the moment. Below though are some compatability patches or notes for mods that do need it.

[u][url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=915966120] Primitive Players[/url],[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=741282313] Pre-FTL Players - All FTL	[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=738842496] Pre-FTL Players[/url] :[/u]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=927287485]Compatibility patch.[/url]
