With the way it is set up currently you don't have to do anything, it all runs in the background basically. Decisions you make will affect them but there is no real direct control you put on them.
This also means that it works perfectly with the AI.

 Hopes and plans for the future: 

> A separate civilian trader faction.
	> there are some specific things I'd like a trader faction to want that don't fit perfectly with the prosperity faction.
	> Having the happiness of the faction effect trade ships/bonuses
> Some connection to the unity system
> War Demands
> Events



 Localization:  
All of these are just English for the moment. Since so much changed basically all the text has changed and I couldn't keep any of the great translations you guys gave me.
There isn't a lot of text this time around so translating shouldn't be too hard. If you want to help I'll post the localization file in a discussion and you can just post it there.

German: English
French: English
Russian: Complete
Brazilian: English
Polish: English

Important for removing the mod! 

Pause the game.
Open the console " ` " 
type in " event civtrade.66 "
Hit enter and all the trade ships should disappear. Then just save a reload. 

 Compatibility:  

This mod should be compatible with most every mod out there at the moment. Below though are some compatability patches or notes for mods that do need it.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=915966120] Primitive Players,[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=741282313] Pre-FTL Players - All FTL	, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=738842496] Pre-FTL Players :
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=927287485]Compatibility patch.

title: Dynamic Mod Menu [3.10.*]
description:
Ever felt like your edicts list becomes cluttered by edicts whose sole purpose is to open the settings of a mod? Here is a lightweight and performance-friendly mod that can solve that issue!

[h1]For players[/h1]
This mod adds a button on the main menu (opened up by pressing escape) that opens the Mod Menu. You can then select the mod you want to access the settings of. Simple right?
The mods simply have to register themselves. If you don't see the mod you're looking for, you can [b]kindly[/b] ask its modder to come see this mod description, so they can see if they want to make their mod register itself.

Concerning the keyboard feature:
You can use SHIFT+A for an A. You can activate capslock with CTRL+C and spaces with CTRL+S. The majority of the special chars need a click (except for + and - with use the numpad + and -).

Place this mod below SWFR and any other mod altering interface/mainmenu_view.gui.
This mod changes checksum and has nearly no compatibility issues.
This mod alters interface/mainmenu_view.gui.
If you don't see the button on the "escape menu", another mod is altering that file. To solve it, you can simply place DMM below it (or at the bottom of the load order).
This mod is save game compatible. It can't be uninstalled during a game.

[h2]Mods supporting DMM[/h2]
This is a non-exhaustive list, if you know of other mods supporting DMM, feel free to comment ;)
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2028826064]A Deadly Tempest[/url] by FirePrince

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727000451]More Events Mod[/url] by Malthus and many others
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2752952962]Realistic Pirates [3.3.☠][/url] by FirePrince
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2460698354]Otter Editor's Dynamic Mod Menu Add-on[/url] by Seamoo
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899795759]Ruler Level System[/url] by jasonpepe
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3088428692]Satisfying Libels and Praises [3.10.*][/url] by TheFlyingPotato
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821711162]! Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger[/url] by ArutamSartek
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2423885359]Space Exploitation[/url] by James Fire
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1712760331]~ StarNet AI[/url] by salvor and OldEnt
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494712590]StarTech AI[/url] by salvor and OldEnt
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3047070190]Technology Diffusion[/url] by StarOri
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2865524513]Uncivic: New Mechanics for Vanilla Civics[/url] by MichaelMakesGames
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2462927769]Weapon Research Menu[/url] by SableDrake
[/list]

[h1]For modders[/h1]
[h2]How to add a button for your mod in DMM[/h2]
This is really straightforward, so don't be afraid ;)
All the infos are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2458024521/3077629031353110169/]here[/url].
I had to move them from this page to that discussion because steam limits the size of the workshop description.

[h2]Keyboard Feature[/h2]
This mod also adds a "keyboard" that allows the player to rename stuff. Simply use [code]dmm_keyboard_rename = { TARGET = thing_to_rename }[/code] in the country scope of the player (you can use event targets for the TARGET).
Once the renaming is done, the on_action [code]dmm_keyboard_rename_finished (this = TARGET, from = player country that renamed)[/code] will be fired. If you use it, use a unique flag to make sure that it was your mod that required the rename and check the scope type before (`is_scope_type = leader` if checking for a leader flag).
See example add-on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2519537561]here[/url]
This feature was codeveloped with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198053578024/myworkshopfiles/?appid=281990]mr_trousers[/url] with some design advice from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/theminxlynx/myworkshopfiles/?appid=281990]TheMinxLynx[/url].

[h2]Template for settings menu[/h2]
You probably know it, modding GUI in Stellaris is quite hard and annoying. But having a good looking event is really nice. So I created a template you can freely use and change!
Checkout [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2458024521/3131667021971880420/]this discussion[/url] for more info on it!

[h1]Credits[/h1]
Thank you to mr_trousers for the keyboard feature and to TheMinxLynx for design advice.
Thank you to Mario for allowing me to use this mod name.
Thank you to OldEnt for making an example template.
Thank you to The Stellaris Modding Den.

[h1]Legal Stuff[/h1]
Do not copy any content from this mod without permission. This includes modpacking of course (instead do a steam collection and let your user merge locally).
You have my permission to use the template (event and gui code files having "template" in the name). Make sure to rename the elements if you change them. Please credit ;)

title: Auto Auto-Explore
description:
[h1][b]Auto-auto-explore gives all empires the "Automated Exploration Protocols" tech at game start[/b][/h1]

I thought it was sooo silly that I had to wait until late game just to essentially offload and ignore one of the most monotonous aspects of Stellaris gameplay, so I made this mod.

If the game or some other addon suddenly creates a new empire and puts it in your galaxy, this addon will give them the auto-explore technology immediately when they research anything else. The first thing they research will also give them "Automated Exploration Protocols". Empires that are present at the start of the game get it immediately.

And so you don't forget that you have it, I did not hide the "research complete" popup.

description:

[h1][b]
[u]This mod is not Iron Man compatible![/u]

It is recommended to use the Irony Mod Manager:
https://github.com/bcssov/IronyModManager/releases.

Big thanks goes to the Gigastructures Mod for their GUI elements and code provided! Praise the Kaiser!

Join ACOT/AoT Discord https://discord.gg/zUu6SuQgRs

[/b][/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Correct load order of Mods:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1419304439]Ancient Cache of Technologies[/url]

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3289877651]ANZ VOIDFRAME[/url] [This requires gigastructural engineering to be loaded above it]
[/olist]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Translations to other languages:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686681456]Chinesisch[/url]

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2780245722]Japanisch[/url]

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3553177968]Spanisch[/url]
[/olist]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/auqdyX6.png[/img]

If you liked the [b]Ancient Cache of Technologies (ACOT)[/b] mod, you may have noticed that it feels like there's some Content missing. This mod aims to seamlessly expand upon the core experience of the ACOT mod. It adds additional building levels, megastructures, and even new ship types. Another mod I also liked is the Planetary Shields mod, but unfortunately, this mod is largely incompatible. Therefore, in this mod, I've added my own shield FX for the Dark Matter and Dark Energy (Sky Shield) installations to give your empire that extra something.

So if you sit in front of your computer and nod your head in agreement, then this mod is for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IZeqVdR.png[/img]
[List]
[*] Added new types of Habitats for Fallen and Ascended Empires that specialize in production of Dark Matter/Energy and later even Stellarite. It comes with the decision to turn your old clunky habitats into the new fancy ones.

[*] Added a complete building line of Stellarite and Phanon type buildings to grant you that extra oomph for your eyes and ego.

[*] Added the ability to resurrect your dead biological leaders and even make them immortal in the process! (Requires Genetical Ascension)

[*] Added the [b]Chrysalis Protocol[/b] which allows you to immediately convert all xeno pops on your planet into your primary species for a price. (Requires Genetical Ascension)

[*] Added Fallen/Ascended variant of the Juggernaut, called Warbarge, to both the Fallen Empires, Ascended Empires and Default Empires. [b]Requires the Federations DLC[/b]

[*] Added planetary shields for the Dark Matter, Dark Energy, Stellarite and Phanon tier shield generator. They can be toggled on/off via the ACOT mod menu!

[*] Reintroduced the Alpha Tier building variants for the Nourishment Center, Auto Forge, Dimensional Fabricator, Affluence Center, Master Archive and Class-4 Singularity.

[*] Added the option to attempt to assemble the Precursor Databank yourself without having to steal it from another fallen empire or having to simp them until they like you enough to give it to you (Requires you to be an ZOFE Ascended Empire).

[*] Changed the Ascended Empire ship designs to use ACOT components because they are more dank compared to the plebian tier 5 gamma lasers. This should also affect lost empires.

[*] Added a new edict that allows you to eliminate all hedonism in your empire after you researched the alpha tier generator.

[*] Fixed the ACOT bombardment FX not appearing on planets and added a lot more planets to be destroyable via Exterminatus or Annihilatus, including [b]Gigastructural[/b] planets!
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DQouMeU.png[/img]

This mod overwrites [b]pdxmesh.shader[/b] so it's incompatible with any mod that does the same.

I added full support for the [b]Event Horizon Offset Facility (EHOF)[/b] though.

[b]Planetary Diversity[/b] is also fully supported to work with this mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/afN85KJ.png[/img]

Q: I like to ascend but I don't like the complete overhaul character and country change mechanic of ZOFE. Is there something similar in functionality?
A: Yes, the  Dawn of Ascension (DoA)mod provides ZOFE like Ascension but without the country change. Which makes this less disruptive to your modlist.

Q: Can I run this mod without ACOT?
A: No. It will crash during the loading screen.

Q: Is this mod compatible with Gigastructures?
A: Yes. Most of its planets and habitats can now be properly destroyed by ACOT bombing stances.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eE1Vc5b.png[/img]

[b]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623423360

[b]Real Space: System Scale/Acquisition of Technology Compatibility Patch[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2245219565

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rer0w92.png[/img]

[*] Reintroduced the Alpha Tier building variants for the Nourishment Center, Auto Forge, Dimensional Fabricator, Affluence Center, Master Archive and Class-4 Singularity.

[*] Added the option to attempt to assemble the Precursor Databank yourself without having to steal it from another fallen empire or having to simp them until they like you enough to give it to you (Requires you to be an ZOFE Ascended Empire).

[*] Changed the Ascended Empire ship designs to use ACOT components because they are more dank compared to the plebian tier 5 gamma lasers. This should also affect lost empires.

[*] Added a new edict that allows you to eliminate all hedonism in your empire after you researched the alpha tier generator.

[*] Fixed the ACOT bombardment FX not appearing on planets and added a lot more planets to be destroyable via Exterminatus or Annihilatus, including Gigastructural planets!


https://i.imgur.com/DQouMeU.png

This mod overwrites pdxmesh.shader so it's incompatible with any mod that does the same.

I added full support for the Event Horizon Offset Facility (EHOF) though.

Planetary Diversity is also fully supported to work with this mod.

https://i.imgur.com/afN85KJ.png

Q: I like to ascend but I don't like the complete overhaul character and country change mechanic of ZOFE. Is there something similar in functionality?
A: Yes, the  Dawn of Ascension (DoA)mod provides ZOFE like Ascension but without the country change. Which makes this less disruptive to your modlist.

Q: Can I run this mod without ACOT?
A: No. It will crash during the loading screen.

Q: Is this mod compatible with Gigastructures?
A: Yes. Most of its planets and habitats can now be properly destroyed by ACOT bombing stances.

title: Fleet Transfer Mod
description:
You have an outdated, extra fleet and you don’t know where to put it, and disband or modify is stingy?
Your vassals suffer from internal feuds or external threats and they lack the fleet, and to solve their problems yourself - laziness?
You want to covertly help another empire without getting directly involved in a conflict?
You have energy credits but you don’t have the capacity or time to build a fleet?
Or you just dreamed of creating a military mega-corporation producing weapons for sale?


[h1]Now all this is possible![/h1]

For implementation all of your ideas, current mod provides new unique features, such as:

[b]1. Fleet transfer[/b]
The transfer is possible in the form of a gift, and you can to demand different types of resources for the fleet: energy credits, minerals, food, consumer goods, alloys.
Mod automatically calculates the market price of the fleets and gives price options to the player to choose for sale, in percentage terms - from a symbolic amount to brazen robbery. Of course, you can set the price manually.

[b]2. Fleet market[/b]
On market you can exhibit up to 6 different fleets for manually set price. By exhibiting fleet, seller loses the ability to control it. Each player can inspect the exhibited fleet and buy it. If the fleet has not been bought within five years, it will be returned to the seller.

[b]3. Fleet rent[/b]
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that the buyer does not receive the fleet forever, but for the time set by the seller. In addition, if the buyer destroys the rented fleet, compensation can be claimed from him or you can impose sanctions on him at all.

[b]4. Fleet auction[/b]
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that there are only three slots for setting fleets, the sale time is limited to one year, and the buyer is the one who offers the highest bet for this year.


[h1]Possible questions:[/h1]

[i]"If I get a fleet with components that I have not yet learned, do I get them automatically?"[/i]
No, these components still need to be studied for installation on your ships. But already installed components from ships will not go anywhere, only if you try to modify ships that have components better than you have studied - you will install your components, not the better ones!

[i]"Can empires like devouring swarms use these functions?"[/i]
No. They hate other races.

[i]"Why it is not allowed to transfer or sell transport ships with armies?"[/i]
At current moment while you are transferring armies they bugged and it’s impossible to use them. Until a solution is found - transport ships with armies is not transmitted.

[i]"I transferred/sold/bought titans, and my counter of them has broken!"[/i]
Such a problem exists. Solution - re-enter in the game. We advise you do not abuse the sale of titans.

[i]"Can I sell federation fleet?"[/i]
No. The federation fleet does not belong to one owner, even if it is the Hegemon - it belongs to the entire federation at once.

[i]"Why I can't to exhibit on Market/Rent/Auction my colossus or juggernaut?"[/i]
Colossus or Juggernauts can be transferred or sold ONLY in the Fleet Transfer Menu. Open trading of such ships is prohibited.

[i]"How can I disable some functions of the mod?"[/i]
[i]"How to forbid AI use functions of the mod?"[/i]
This can be done in the mod settings window. To get there, you need to open the market, rental or auction window, and in the top left corner, near the close button of the window, press on the settings button. If these functions are already disabled, the settings button will appear in the fleet transfer menu.

description_clean:
You have an outdated, extra fleet and you don’t know where to put it, and disband or modify is stingy?
Your vassals suffer from internal feuds or external threats and they lack the fleet, and to solve their problems yourself - laziness?
You want to covertly help another empire without getting directly involved in a conflict?
You have energy credits but you don’t have the capacity or time to build a fleet?
Or you just dreamed of creating a military mega-corporation producing weapons for sale?


Now all this is possible!

For implementation all of your ideas, current mod provides new unique features, such as:

1. Fleet transfer
The transfer is possible in the form of a gift, and you can to demand different types of resources for the fleet: energy credits, minerals, food, consumer goods, alloys.
Mod automatically calculates the market price of the fleets and gives price options to the player to choose for sale, in percentage terms - from a symbolic amount to brazen robbery. Of course, you can set the price manually.

2. Fleet market
On market you can exhibit up to 6 different fleets for manually set price. By exhibiting fleet, seller loses the ability to control it. Each player can inspect the exhibited fleet and buy it. If the fleet has not been bought within five years, it will be returned to the seller.

3. Fleet rent
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that the buyer does not receive the fleet forever, but for the time set by the seller. In addition, if the buyer destroys the rented fleet, compensation can be claimed from him or you can impose sanctions on him at all.

4. Fleet auction
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that there are only three slots for setting fleets, the sale time is limited to one year, and the buyer is the one who offers the highest bet for this year.


Possible questions:

"If I get a fleet with components that I have not yet learned, do I get them automatically?"
No, these components still need to be studied for installation on your ships. But already installed components from ships will not go anywhere, only if you try to modify ships that have components better than you have studied - you will install your components, not the better ones!

"Can empires like devouring swarms use these functions?"
No. They hate other races.

"Why it is not allowed to transfer or sell transport ships with armies?"
At current moment while you are transferring armies they bugged and it’s impossible to use them. Until a solution is found - transport ships with armies is not transmitted.

"I transferred/sold/bought titans, and my counter of them has broken!"
Such a problem exists. Solution - re-enter in the game. We advise you do not abuse the sale of titans.

"Can I sell federation fleet?"
No. The federation fleet does not belong to one owner, even if it is the Hegemon - it belongs to the entire federation at once.

"Why I can't to exhibit on Market/Rent/Auction my colossus or juggernaut?"
Colossus or Juggernauts can be transferred or sold ONLY in the Fleet Transfer Menu. Open trading of such ships is prohibited.

"How can I disable some functions of the mod?"
"How to forbid AI use functions of the mod?"
This can be done in the mod settings window. To get there, you need to open the market, rental or auction window, and in the top left corner, near the close button of the window, press on the settings button. If these functions are already disabled, the settings button will appear in the fleet transfer menu.

title: Marauders Remodeled
description:
Please use this fork for gameplay: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2936292863 this shit aint been updated for years.
Free to update or use in Stellaris by anyone. Go ham.

A graphical* mod that replaces the default Marauder models with something more fitting their style and lore. Now centuries old spacebound warrior clans no longer use asteroids and scrap to make their ships. The designs are decaying mid-tech and brutalistic, but built using centuries of shipbuilding experience, culture, and practicality. Its got working turrets too, because everyone likes turrets for some reason. 

[b]THIS IS NOT AN EMPIRE SHIPSET.[/b] It does not contain nearly enough models to be made into one either, so I will not be making it into a shipset.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b][i]Ships created by MSGDI:[/i][/b] https://sketchfab.com/MSGDI/models
He has improved greatly since he created these models long ago.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: 3D Fleet Formation
description:
This mod is a rework of the mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1241520305] Fleet Scale [/url] once created by@Magog 
Since the former creator stopped updating anymore, and I personally believe this mod is a "must-have". So I decided to upload this new version and continue the update. I also made a little optimation to make it fit even better.

[h1]-What Does This Mod Do-[/h1]
Unlike other mods who intended to expand the scale of the fleets simply on wide which result in the ships too spread out. This mod changes the fleet formation on 3D perspective, not simply makes the gaps between ships wider, but also expands them on height, makes them fit better and will not "collide into each other".
I even would recommend you to use this mod with those mods who provide bigger ship class such like NSC2.

[h1]- Compatibility -[/h1]
This mod only changes the three following scripts in the folder: "/defines"
[SHIP_RANDOM_HEIGHT_OFFSET = 75  # vanilla = 15.0]
[FLEET_BASE_FORMATION_SCALE = 4.0  # vanilla = 2.0]
[FLEET_BASE_FORMATION_DIV	= 12  # vanilla = 10]
So any mod that does not change those scripts will be totally compatible.

title: [ON HOLD] The Merger of Rules 3.14
description:
This mod serves as a global compatibility patch for Stellaris 3.14, designed to harmonize the various incompatible game rules and scripted triggers introduced by different mods.
When two mods alter the same rule or scripted trigger, only the last loaded mod takes effect, potentially causing issues with the earlier mod. The Merger resolves this by ensuring that all relevant rules from multiple mods are applied seamlessly.
In addition to merging game rules, this mod also integrates several common scripted triggers shared by multiple mods, such as is_megacorp or the capital buildings triggers. This integration allows for the construction of buildings from different mods, provided you have an equivalent capital on your planet.

Furthermore, the mod includes a shader merge for ACOT/AOT, Gigas, and Real Space, ensuring visual compatibility across these popular mods.

I will only add mods that have been made for, or updated to 3.14.*

You will need this mod if you use more than one of the following mods:
I've hit the size limit for this description so you'll find the list as a collection instead.

[h1]-> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2604226821]Supported Mods for 3.X[/url] <-[/h1]

Make sure to place the Merger at the end of your load order.

Modders, if you have specific worlds that you don't want to be targeted by planet killers, flag them with planet_flag = merg_forbidden_target and the Merger will make sure that, modded or vanilla, they won't break your mod.
You can also detect the presence of the Merger with the global flag merged_rules.

[h1]Recommended:[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588]Universal Resource Patch[/url]

[h1]Mini-Patch:[/h1]
These patches are mandatory for the support of their mod.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410671527]Expanded Events[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410670780]Expanded Megastructures and Technologies[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410670611]Expanded Traits, Civics, Pops, and More[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3280119957]Girls Frontline[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3302382866]Leviathan Events Xtended - Legacy[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410676642]Madoka Magica New[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3424044503]Plentiful Traditions[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3279553160]Real Space[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410670415]Wula Fallen Empire[/url]

[h1]Incompatible mods[/h1]
[i]Universial Game Rules Patch[/i] - You don't need UGRC as I cover more mods while making the rules to acknowledge the existence of other mods, but if your collection of mods is mainly Chinese, you'll want to use it instead.
[i]Various Servant Jobs[/i] - this will cause habitability bugs.
[i]Ethics and Civics Alternative Restored[/i] - has completely messed up policies files.
[i]Prime Collective Crisis - Pandora's Star[/i] - causes zero habitability bug.
[i]Habitable Structures Patch[/i] - made obsolete since Stellaris 3.0 totally changed how the trigger works, and will be overwritten by the Merger.
Any total conversion or global overhaul.

[h1]Recommended load order[/h1]
[b]Ariphaos Unofficial Patch[/b] or [b]Scripted Trigger Undercoat[/b]
<Your mods here, check mods descriptions for specific instructions>
<The patch mods come after, to be able to overwrite the previous mods they're supposed to patch>
[b]Universal Resource Patch[/b]
[b]The Merger of Rules[/b]

[h1]Troubleshooting[/h1]
Steam sometimes fails to update mod files correctly. Performing regular integrity checks on the game usually resolves this issue.

[h1]Other Compatibility patches[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2178603631]ACOT + Dawn of Ascension -> Acquisition of Technology[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821711162]Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877750087]Sartek District and Economy Merger Add-on[/url]

[h1]Legal[/h1]
You're not allowed to redistribute this mod, with the exception of private multiplayer packs.
You can add portions of the code to your own mod, but please notify me if you do so.
The above rules don't apply if you fork the Merger to support an overhaul/conversion mod.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2828656792]Русская Локализация[/url]

[h1]Notes for modders[/h1]
- Add comments when you overwrite vanilla code, to make it easier to see where the code has changed.
- Favor creating and using scripted triggers whenever you're checking for a list of things, also if you're restricting to some country types.
Adding compatibility to an event restricted to country_type = default requires overwriting the event, but if you used a trigger, it's much easier to overwrite it.
- Write a changelog. This helps a lot more than you might think.
- Concerning ID triggers:
It's a simple thing - add in your mod a trigger stating for example trg_my_mod = { always = yes }
Other mods that want to check on yours will have a placeholder file set to be easily overwritten and put trg_my_mod = { always = no }
The big advantage over a global flag is that this allows for detection before game start, essential for policies, pop assembly, buildings, etc.

[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/bHVez2C][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

title: AshArms Aquarius History
description:
[h1]灰烬战线水瓶座の历史[/h1]

[b]时间的脚步继续向前，无尽的过去成为历史。
The steps of time continue to move forward, endless past become history.
City，最后的生存之地，已成为曾经的记忆。
City, the last place to live, has become a memory.
在我们自己的战火中我们的文明得以幸存，这给予了我们无尽的机会。当我们再次展望星空......
Our civilization has survived our own wars, and that has given us endless opportunities. As we look into the stars again......
我们已灰烬中崛起，文明将在废墟中复兴。
We will rise from the ashes, and the civilization will shine again.[/b]

感谢各位对我们的支持，如今我们对各位玩家的程度已逐一兑现，我们可以在上午时刻浏览水瓶座帝国曾经的历史，坐在方舟铸造厂的光桥上看着忙碌的哨兵，亦或是回到母星看着一片繁荣的景色，一切似乎都在往好的方向发展。

继承了灰烬Mod的所有，灰烬部分的内容依旧是基于Embers Studio工作室旗下游戏《AshArms》的畅想式延伸MOD。
依旧是讲述以游戏主时间线为背景时间线延伸至2200年时City的现状为背景建立的星际时代故事线。
目前提供游戏内195个Dolls的立绘、皮肤、战斗形态立绘与联动人物立绘等，以及部分可选剧情人物立绘。
MOD会不定期随着游戏内新增立绘或者MOD新增事件进行更新
并且会逐步的完善与失落帝国合并后文本的不对口问题。

[h1]本MOD包含了以下内容[/h1]
[code]1.195个Dolls的立绘、皮肤、战斗形态立绘，以及部分可选剧情人物立绘。
2.新的巨塔议会政体
3.新增科技树
4.新增新稀有资源
5.新增新的武器Type和循环科研
6.新的飞升
7.新增少量事件。
8.完成部分Mod单向联动。
9.新增武器和组件
10.新增失落帝国舰船
11.新建天灾
12.新的遗珍
13.新的巨型结构
14.新的利维坦剧情
15.新的种族特质
16.新野怪类型[/code]

[h1]下阶段计划[/h1]
[code]1.增加更多立绘
2.定做载入图
3.主界面制作
4.完善与失落帝国衔接处的不协调问题[/code]

如果订阅的MOD导致战略资源冲突不显示，请订阅该MOD

title: !-Starbase - Extended-!
description:
Compatible with 3.7.X ✔️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ilmZlI8.png[/img]

[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]

Hey guys have you ever wanted to have an empire which relies a lot on Starbase like the marauders ? Well then I guarantie you that you have come to the right place.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4FuU1Y4.png[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

Here the goal is to make the Starbase as much important as a Colony. With some editing on the starbase_view.gui I have managed to increase the maximum slots amount of modules and buildings up to 24, almost as big as a 25 tiles Colony. Each level will have an increased amout of module/building slots.

- Starport : 6 Modules / 4 Buildings
- Starhold : 12 Modules / 9 Buildings
- Fortress : 16 Modules / 14 Buildings
- Citadel : 21 Modules / 21 Buildings
- Stronghold : 28 Modules / 28 Buildings
- Headquarters: 35 Modules / 35 Buildings

Some people might be wondering why having such an amount of free slots, well that is to experience the high amount of new Starbase modules and buildings coming with that mod allowing you to endlessly customize it.

The AI will use the mod properly.

With that mod players will be able to rely on their Starbase to build a strong economy or even hold against the strong fleets of the endgame.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4FuU1Y4.png[/img]

[h1]COMPATIBILITY[/h1]

Many files dealing with the starbase have been overwriten, however I decided to follow the way how NCS worked so people using that mod will still be able to have a nice compability. Here is a list of the overwritten files:
[list]
    [*]Stellaris\interface\starbase_view.gui
    [*]Stellaris\common\section_templates\starbase.txt
    [*]Stellaris\common\ship_sizes\00_starbases.txt
    [*]Stellaris\common\starbase_levels\00_starbase_levels.txt
    [*]Stellaris\common\starbase_modules\00_starbase_modules.txt
[/list]

List of mods compatible:
[list]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=683230077]New Ship Classes[/url]
[/list]

Special credits for the UI code to:
[list]
    [*]Orrie for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url]
    [*]SableDrake for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2807539630]Tiny Starbase Modules and Buildings[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ydr2SQm.png[/img]

[h1]MORE INFORMATIONS[/h1]

- That mod should be compatible with multiplayer.
- That mod should be compatible with old saves but I advice not doing that.
- Some files about starbase were replaced so be careful with any other mod doing the same thing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/bHVez2C][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Z8X68t.png[/img][/url]

title: Potent Rebellions (3.3 currently discontinued)
description:
This mod significantly expands the Vanilla rebellion mechanics to make them a more significant threat to established empires. As it is, rebellions are fairly rare and pose virtually no threat whatsoever to your empire, as the revolutionaries start with huge disadvantages: They are one planet and have no fleet. Only in exceptional circumstances will they seek to join a larger empire. A successful revolution will also not impact on the likelihood of more planets revolting. One can therefore safely ignore unrest, or at least treat it as a minor annoyance.

This mod changes all that, through several measures that basically buff revolts and add more reasons for revolts to happen:

 -[b]Sow Unrest[/b]: Sow unrest in nearby planets using a planetary edict, unlockable by tech. Adds unrest and unhappiness modifiers to planets that are in range.
 -[b]Subsidise Rebels[/b]: Successful rebellions will ask nearby countries that are hostile to the country they are rebelling from to subsidise them. These countries can also gift them a fleet if their own fleet is strong enough (at least 200).
 -[b]Give the rebels resources[/b]: Rebellions are given a fleet based on their fleet capacity, an offensive army, unity (they used to start from scratch), and temporary modifiers that help them support their fleet and get themselves off the ground. However, without subsidies they will still not pose an existential threat unless there are multiple rebellions at once (which is now possible).
 -[b]Revolt into bigger countries[/b]: Rebels will now merge into a bigger country wherever that makes sense. Previously, they would only join their original owners if they were a nationalist revolt or an egalitarian empire if they were slaves. Now, they will join any country that is of their species, including, say, one that has emerged via a revolt.
 -[b]Introduce waves of unrest[/b]: If one planet successfully revolts, and you own other planets with high unrest, there is a chance (scaled by unrest levels and whether their grievance is the same) that they will attempt to revolt as well over the next few months (capped at six months, unless further revolts succeed). If a nationalist revolt succeeds, all pops in the empire of the same species will also get -20% happiness for 5 years.
 -[b]Expanded Slave Revolt Mechanics[/b]: New empires emerging from slave revolts are given unique names, name lists, emblems and special civics. The civic 'Free Republic' grants +15% Egalitarian Attraction and +15% fire rate when at war with a slaveowning empire, and 'Breaker of Shackles' creates unrest in neighbouring countries' slave populations at the cost of massive relations penalties with slaveowner empires that make peaceful coexistence almost impossible. The AI will only use these civics (and names, emblems etc) when there is a slave revolt. You can select them for your own campaign, though (but only both at once), or pick the prescripted empire I made.
 -[b]State vulnerability[/b]: If a state is severely defeated in war or has hostile neighbours that are ‘overwhelmingly’ more powerful than it, its population will lose confidence in it. It will be given penalties to ethics divergence, unrest and happiness (especially in oppressed pops). This means that a state that has ‘had it’ will fall apart, as has tended to happen historically. [b]Note[/b]: If you have your fleet at 90% fleet capacity, you cannot get this modifier (as the population know you are doing your best).
 -[b]Patriotic Revolts[/b]: If you are at war with an empire and have pops of their species, they will be unhappy and my try to revolt. If they succeed and join them, but you win the war convincingly (the main opponent must end up with pathetic fleet power vs you, and if the country that your planets revolted to is a secondary war participant, that planet must have at least inferior fleet power), you will claim the planets back.

In terms of balance and gameplay, I hope that this will create a more fluid mid and late game, with rebellions hopefully breaking the stalemate that tends to emerge between the powerful empires, and allowing failed states to fade into obscurity. I also hope that this will provide challenges for the player, forcing them to administer their empire well or risk it falling apart (something that I have made a real possibility).

[b]The Future[/b]: I've added all the features I want to add to this mod, and now work for Paradox, but I intend to keep this up to date.

[b]Feedback[/b]: If you see anything weird, let me know! Also tell me if you think it is too hard or too easy (for you or the AI), so I can continue to refine the balance. Finally, if you like this mod, please [img]http://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

This mod significantly expands the Vanilla rebellion mechanics to make them a more significant threat to established empires. As it is, rebellions are fairly rare and pose virtually no threat whatsoever to your empire, as the revolutionaries start with huge disadvantages: They are one planet and have no fleet. Only in exceptional circumstances will they seek to join a larger empire. A successful revolution will also not impact on the likelihood of more planets revolting. One can therefore safely ignore unrest, or at least treat it as a minor annoyance.

This mod changes all that, through several measures that basically buff revolts and add more reasons for revolts to happen:

 -Sow Unrest: Sow unrest in nearby planets using a planetary edict, unlockable by tech. Adds unrest and unhappiness modifiers to planets that are in range.
 -Subsidise Rebels: Successful rebellions will ask nearby countries that are hostile to the country they are rebelling from to subsidise them. These countries can also gift them a fleet if their own fleet is strong enough (at least 200).
 -Give the rebels resources: Rebellions are given a fleet based on their fleet capacity, an offensive army, unity (they used to start from scratch), and temporary modifiers that help them support their fleet and get themselves off the ground. However, without subsidies they will still not pose an existential threat unless there are multiple rebellions at once (which is now possible).
 -Revolt into bigger countries: Rebels will now merge into a bigger country wherever that makes sense. Previously, they would only join their original owners if they were a nationalist revolt or an egalitarian empire if they were slaves. Now, they will join any country that is of their species, including, say, one that has emerged via a revolt.
 -Introduce waves of unrest: If one planet successfully revolts, and you own other planets with high unrest, there is a chance (scaled by unrest levels and whether their grievance is the same) that they will attempt to revolt as well over the next few months (capped at six months, unless further revolts succeed). title: Real Space - Star Cluster
description:
[b]Real Space - Star Cluster v 1.5[/b]

[b]This version is compatible with patch 3.*.*.[/b]

[b][url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1188397501]Compatibility Patch Collection[/url][/b]

[table]
[tr]
[th][url=boosty.to/annatar108] [img]https://imgur.com/ZEBNNJB.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=discord.gg/tCpXcNs] [img]https://imgur.com/K3aIvKq.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=vk.com/realspacemod] [img]https://imgur.com/dwMExTS.png[/img][/url][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EjzuguR.png[/img]

The essence of this mod is simple - the galaxy is too huge to include only a few hundred stars. And in my deep conviction, Stellaris technically and gameplay reveals itself only on small maps (although now all map sizes are available). This mod removes the galaxy map completely. Now you play only in a small area of ​​space, which is a grain of sand on the shore of the galactic ocean from a myriad of stars.

[h1][b]If in more detail, then this mod includes several major changes.[/b][/h1]

[b]Graphic changes:[/b]
- The galaxy map now no longer looks like a galaxy map. I had to make space black, but I realized that for the tactical information panel of the starry sky it would not look spectacular and convenient.
- The vast majority of stars will now have a black skybox of the starry sky (well, not quite black, the Milky Way is visible).

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
All gameplay changes relate to map generation. The map is a torn star cluster with 5 star clusters, upon entering which you will receive a message about the nature of each area.
In a sense, this mod is an experiment. If the players like it, I will be ready to develop it. You can add more options with more and fewer stars and more cluster options that will be random.

[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]

It is not recommended to use this mod without Real Space. Small problems may arise associated with the generation of 5 additional clusters.

Absolutely, the mod is not compatible with mods that add or modify the galaxy map. The same applies to mods adding new skyboxes for system maps.

[img]https://imgur.com/8hXVs7X.png[/img]

[b]My work is completely dependent on your donations. I have a lot of plans, friends, but they will be realized only thanks to you.[/b]

[i]As of late, Patreon no longer works for me. I can only get your help through [url=boosty.to/annatar108]Boosty[/url] and am switching to the new support model. You can now choose which project to support. I will be able to start upgrading as soon as we raise the necessary amount. The good news is that updates will appear immediately on Steam and will be available to everyone.[/i]

[url=boosty.to/annatar108][img]https://imgur.com/TA1b8DC.png[/img][/url]

title: Azur Lane Ship Class
description:
[h1]碧蓝航线 新舰船类别拓展包（已停用）[/h1]

本MOD为[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1617872589]碧蓝航线主题DLC[/url]的可选内容拓展包。

为游戏添加了11种新舰种，背景来源为碧蓝航线游戏内的舰种，并为每个新舰种设计了多款可选择区段。并为这些舰种适配了合适的反应堆以及各个舰船部件，包括原版内容和碧蓝航线主MOD的内容~
其中包括从驱逐舰到舰队母舰多种舰种可供选择，详情见列表说明~

[b]说明[/b]
本mod只提供舰船类别，并无任何船模内容。并且理论上兼容一切船模MOD~
适配的舰船部件为全新制作，所以不会出现什么兼容问题。
但其中一些必要的科技加成，必须涉及到一些原版科技的修改，请悉知。
使用时，请将本mod放置在主MOD下方加载。
[h1]Language：简体中文，English[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/08/20/OWh7pJmokgalys4.png[/img]
[h1]火炮驱逐舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：3 由驱逐舰科技解锁
[b]火炮驱逐舰[/b] 为原版驱逐舰的火力增幅版，能装配更强的火力，并拥有更好的防护性能。
配置有：[b]重炮舰艏 联装舰艏，重炮舰艉 联装舰艉 功能型舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]导弹驱逐舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：3 由驱逐舰科技解锁
[b]导弹驱逐舰[/b] 为原版驱逐舰的火力增幅版，拥有纯粹的导弹槽（G槽），并拥有更好的防护性能。
配置有：[b]导弹舰艏，导弹舰艉 功能型舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]轻巡洋舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：5 由巡洋舰科技解锁
[b]轻巡洋舰[/b] 为原版巡洋舰的增幅版，能搭载更为丰富的火力配置，并拥有更好的防护性能。
配置有：[b]主炮舰艏 副炮舰艏 导弹舰艏，主炮核心 副炮核心 导弹核心，主炮舰艉  副炮舰艉 导弹舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]重巡洋舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：6 由巡洋舰科技解锁
[b]重巡洋舰[/b] 为原版巡洋舰的更强增幅版，能搭载非常强力的火力配置，并拥有更好的防护性能。
配置有：[b]主炮舰艏 强袭舰艏，重炮核心 近卫核心 强袭核心 主炮核心，主炮舰艉  联装舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]超巡洋舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：7 由战列舰科技解锁
[b]超巡洋舰[/b] 为原版战列舰的小幅弱化版，能搭载轴基主炮（X槽）以及相对极端的火力配置，并拥有更高的机动性。
配置有：[b]巨炮舰艏 主炮舰艏 强袭舰艏，主炮核心 联装核心 强袭核心，主炮舰艉  副炮舰艉 导弹舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]轻型航空母舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：6 由巡洋舰科技解锁
[b]轻型航空母舰[/b] 为原版巡洋舰的舰载机特化版，能搭载大量舰载机（H槽），并拥有很高的机动性，但防护水平略差。
配置有：[b]近卫前甲板 主炮前甲板，近卫核心 导弹核心，近卫舰艉 副炮舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]航空母舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：10 由战列舰科技解锁
[b]航空母舰[/b] 为原版战列舰的舰载机特化版，能搭载大量舰载机（H槽），拥有出色防御，并拥有很高的机动性。
配置有：[b]标准前甲板 巨炮舰艏，航空核心 近卫核心 导弹核心，近卫舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]巡洋战舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：10 由战列舰科技解锁
[b]巡洋战舰[/b] 为原版战列舰的增幅版，能搭载更强大的武备，拥有更丰富的武器选择，并拥有不俗的防护与机动性。
配置有：[b]巨炮舰艏 联合舰艏，联合核心 主炮核心 强袭主炮核心 强袭飞弹核心，主炮舰艉 强袭舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]重装战舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：12 由战列舰科技解锁
[b]重装战舰[/b] 为原版战列舰的强力增幅版，能搭载非常强大的火力配置，拥有更丰富的武器选择，并且拥有出色的防护性能。
配置有：[b]主炮舰艏 超限巨炮舰艏 巨炮舰艏，联合核心 主炮核心 强袭主炮核心 导弹核心，巨炮舰艉 主炮舰艉 强袭舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]主力战舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：18 由泰坦科技解锁
[b]主力战舰[/b] 为原版泰坦的增幅版，但没有搭载光环设备，且不受建造数量限制。能搭载夸张的火力配置，拥有更丰富的武器选择，并且拥有极佳的防护性能。
配置有：[b]泰坦舰艏 超限巨炮舰艏 巨炮舰艏，巨炮核心 强袭主炮核心 导弹核心，强袭主炮舰艉 航空舰艉 主炮舰艉 导弹舰艉[/b] 可供选择。
[h1]舰队母舰[/h1]
海军容量占用：24 由主宰科技解锁
[b]舰队母舰[/b] 为原版主宰的减配版，不能作为造船厂使用，可以编入舰队。能搭载强力火力配置，并且拥有极佳的防护性能。
配置有：[b]标准母舰核心，航空母舰核心，重炮母舰核心[/b] 可供选择。

title: [DO NOT USE - 3.14 Legacy] Star Wars: New Dawn
description:
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3575236236]Click here for the updated version of Star Wars: New Dawn.[/url][/h1]
[h1]Unsub from this version of the mod if you wish to play the 4.x version[/h1]
[h1]3.14.* Compatible Only. This version of the mod is no longer supported and any bug reports from the 3.14 version will be ignored.[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLFqzW0.png[/img]

[b]Star Wars: New Dawn[/b] is a total conversion mod set in the aftermath of Revenge of the Sith, spanning the rise of the Empire and the Galactic Civil War. The mod  provides a full overhaul to Stellaris with handmade events, expanded mechanics, and lots of brand new content.

Play any of dozens of iconic Star Wars factions. Will you crush dissent as the Empire, save the galaxy as the Alliance, or start as an underdog and carve a story all your own? 

Languages:
English with community created translation add-ons (Spanish/German/Chinese/Russian, see below)

[h2]Major Features[/h2]

[b]The Galaxy:[/b]
New Dawn is set on a handmade galaxy map at four different sizes each with meaningful customization options. 

[b]A story or a sandbox:[/b]
Play in the full Star Wars universe following the story as it unfolds, or play sandbox mode in the Star Wars setting.

[b]Ships:[/b]
Unique shipsets covering all countries, featuring Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance, Mandalorians, Confederates, and Chiss designs.

[b]Species:[/b]
Over 100 custom species ranging from the iconic Bothans, Ewoks, Hutts, Twi’leks, and Wookiees to the often overlooked Arcona, Ishi Tib, Kubaz, Tiss'shar, and Vagaari.

[b]Events:[/b]
Dozens of new events, dig sites, and crisis chains including:
[list]
[*]The Galactic Civil War. Rebel raids, Imperial operations, Mandalorian clan conflicts, and the rise of the Empire.
[*]Hidden formable countries.
[*]The Mandalorian Civil War mid-game event chain
[*]Imperial and Mandalorian Crusader player-crisis paths. 
[*]The Yuuzhan Vong invasion.
[/list]

[h2]Featured Mechanics[/h2]

[b]Rise of the Empire:[/b]
The Republic, victor of the Clone Wars, is gone. In its place rises the tyrannical Empire, which demands submission from all. The game begins at this pivotal moment. The Empire needs to consolidate its power, the voices of freedom need to find their strength. Play or watch as the Galactic Civil War unfolds through subjugation, intrigue, and finally, [i]total war.[/i]

[b]Institutions[/b] provide new ways to influence or interfere with your neighbors, as well as bring prosperity to your empire through various means:
[list]
[*]Gaining unique building options for certain empires like COMPNOR Arcology for the Galactic Empire or the Mandalorian Recruitment Center for the Mandalorians.
[*]Hire Confederate veterans and their fleets as the Corporate Sector Authority or fund uprisings in the underworld as the Hutt Council.
[*]And many more!
[/list]

[b]Tales from the Cantina[/b] lead to brand new dig sites and event chains.Track down lost holocrons, forgotten superweapons, and other powerful relics as well as a myriad of new galactic specimens.

[b]Secrets of the Ancients:[/b]  Piece together artifacts of legendary civilizations like the Celestials and Rakata to uncover their advanced technologies and rebuild awe-inspiring megastructures from a bygone era.

[b]Ship retirement system[/b] allowing players to have greater control of what ships will appear in their rosters. Use it to phase out older Clone War-era designs in favor of modernized designs or simply reduce the amount of variants in the ship designer.

[b]Mandalorian clan mechanic[/b] inspired by the Klingon Great House Mechanic from Star Trek: New Civilizations. Mandalorian players can foster relationships between important clans of the Galactic Civil War era such as Kryze, Saxon, and Wren. 

[b]One map, two settings, four sizes each.[/b] Play on either the canon map - which starts the player off with preset borders, multiple systems, and access story events - or play on the sandbox map which is a single planet, vanilla-like start.

[b]New megastructures[/b] such as Orbital shipyards, XQ2 trading stations, and Tibanna Mining Platforms.

[h2]DLC Support:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Apocalypse: the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station (the Death Star) will be available for the Galactic Empire.
[*]Megacorp: corporate authorities will be available and certain countries replaced with corporate variants. Additionally, Rebel-aligned factions will be able to build unique holdings. Players without the DLC will still be able to play these empires but without the megacorp features.
[*]Nemesis: the Empire will have better use of their crisis mechanics and both the Hutts and Mandalorians will gain access to unique espionage operations. Players without the DLC will still be able to push the galaxy towards the Galactic Civil War.
[*]Various other additions with non-species DLCs. As of 0.9, we do not use anything from any of the species DLCs in our mod.
[*]No DLC is required for the mod to work.
[/list]

[h2]Translating Submods[/h2]:
Russian: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2743725812
Spanish: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=2957715661
Chinese: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3133968900
German: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3323412314

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3241944359]shrimpAI for Total Conversions[/url] is supported. Load order does not matter as per the mod description.
[*]Other mods are usually [b]not[/b] compatible with this or any total conversion mod.
[/list]

Availability:
[b]New Dawn is only available from this Steam Workshop page.[/b]

[h3]Keep Involved: [/h3]
Consider joining our Discord to receive progress reports on the mod, coordinate and join multiplayer games, interact with the dev team and the community, suggest new features and events, and be the first to learn of secrets and future content.

[url=https://discord.gg/renegades-m-g-community-832957958219759637] [img]https://imgur.com/JOxzf5B.png[/img] [/url]


[h3]Click on this banner to see more mods made by RMG members[/h3]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2469745470][img]https://i.ibb.co/wrZ6NBv/FINAL-BUTTON.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Credits:[/h3] 
New Dawn was based on the earlier Star Wars: Fallen Republic mod.
Specific credits be found in the game's main menu under Credits and a detailed list with more information in the mod's "Credits" file.
Special thanks to Gatekeeper and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url] team for allowing us to use their planet backgrounds.

[i]Star Wars and all of related logos, icons, marks, and characters are solely owned by The Walt Disney Company. This total conversion mod is not endorsed, sponsored, or affiliated with The Walt Disney Company, Lucasfilm Ltd. LLC, Electronic Arts, or any other publisher or producer of Star Wars related media. No independent rights will be asserted against The Walt Disney Company, Lucasfilm Ltd. LLC, or Electronic Arts and no commercial exhibition or distribution will be permitted. This is entirely a community-driven, non-profit project.[/i]

title: ! Real Galaxy HD vanilla
description:
I like the Real Galaxy very much, but there are still some flaws with this mod. Stellaris does not support image larger than 4K for particle FX, then when you put your camera too close to the galaxy plane, you will see rough pixels.
So I made some improvements in this mod:

[h2]Adjust the 4K Galaxy map to 8K to give more details when zooming in.
Remade the stars maps, reducing the size of each star, and improve the total resolution. So you can see the spherical shape instead of a huge pixel mass when zooming in.[/h2]

[h2]Compatibility:[/h2]
Mods changed galaxy size may not compatible, for this mod lock galaxy size for all vanilla setting. This means a 200 stars galaxy will be as large as a 1000 stars galaxy.

title: Plentiful Traditions - Outdated after 2.x and up
description:
[h1]MOD IN HIATUS - USE MY WORK AS YOU SEE FIT - I WISH YOU ALL THE BEST - BLESS YOUR FAMILIES AND CATS _ NO MORE TIME TO WORK ON THIS, MY CHILD IS YOURS[/h1]

[h1]Use "Expanded Stellaris Traditions" by Girion instead http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=946222466 ![/h1]

[h1]Plentiful Traditions[/h1]
Game version: 1.9.*

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

[h1]Description[/h1]
This is a mod that adds a lot of new traditions by the addition of [b]thirteen[/b] tradition trees. It's mostly a mod I made for myself, but perhaps some of you enjoy it as well.

As featured on the official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/140044892]Paradox Stellaris Mod Highlight Stream[/url], [url=https://odingaming.com/2017/05/02/stellaris-mod-roundup-may-17/]Odin Gaming[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StellarisGame/status/936640149395574786]"Mod Friday #3"[/url] and by Paradox themselves.
[list]
[*]Cybernetics - A tradition tree that focuses on robot productivity, physics, new building, synths and energy production.
[*]Biogenesis - Gene-therapy, locust swarms, food, biology, growth, society and grafting your empire into perfection.
[*]Faith - Spiritualism based tree focused on government attraction and edict bonuses.
[*]Order - Traditions that help to strive in removing chaos from the universe. Ship and FTL speed, false flag attacks, sabotage, voidcraft and engineering.
[*]Aspiration - Tradition tree that has trade, opinion, industry and relations at its core.
[*]Malice - For the more evil and daring empires, lower your opinion with nearby empires to taunt them into a war. Slavery, evil and suffering. Other empires WILL hate you.
[*]Affinity - Xenophiles will welcome this tree a lot. Migration, attraction, leaders and society.
[*]Mutagenesis - Intended for Hiveminds or similar empires. Other living organisms are nothing but building blocks towards the perfection of our collective. Toxic Plague war demand, food and society buildings, habitability, regenerative hulls. A more aggressive approach to altering the genes in favor of the great collective.
[*]Industry - Industrial empires that care about mining, extracting, cargo and raw ingenuity to get things done without wasting effort and materials on too much elegance. If it works, it works. Planetary eruptions, ionized excavations, obital fracking cannons, purification facilities, multiple planetary edicts, an empire wide edict and a new building.
[*]Mysticism - Protecting the core life values through compassion, frugality and modesty, Mysticism is a spiritual/pacifist/ecological tradition tree, that is very close to nature and inner peace, unless severely threatened. New buildings (3 obelisks and a sanctum) to preserve life and to provide unity among the people, a new planetary edict (Sacred Act) and the ability to colonize even the most devastated Tomb worlds as they do deserve redemption.
Kleptocracy - Ruthless groups of entities, that often enforce their will on less capable ones. Business is done more frequent and effective when our business-partners are 'convinced' to do so by any means. New building, energy planetary edict, naval capacity and border size, trade bonuses and offensive capacilities.
Factions - Three new factions, Mystics (Mysticism), Miners (Industry) and Syndicates (Kleptocracy).
[/list]
[list]
[*]NEW! - Experimentalism - A tradition tree solely focused on revealing the secrets (physics) of the universe in a scientific way. For a more pacifist/materialist way of play, where research (physics) is everything.
[*]NEW! - Anguish - War, warfare, damage, military and destruction of anyone and anything that threatens you. Going to war is great!
[/list]

[h1]Planned[/h1]
[list]
[*] More to come!
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
It works great with other mods, except for other mods that touch the "topbar_traditions_view.gui" file since that file is used to create the tradition UI.

[h1]Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]
[b]Does this work for existing saves?[/b]
Yes, as long as they meet the current game version.

[b]Will you add more unique Ascension Perks?[/b]
Don't know, there are plenty of other mods for this, but there's a new great perk mod called [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1067631798]Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks by Girion[/url].

[b]Will you add compatibility with other tradition mods?[/b]
Unlikely, but there is a compatibility patch for:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910355834&searchtext=additional+traditions]Additional Traditions by Meltup[/url] located [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266809457]here[/url].
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1100284147]Ethic&Government Traditions Rebuild by petruxa[/url] located [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266630766]here[/url].

[h1]Credits[/h1]

title: *Remastered Human Portraits
description:
Updated for version 3.4 +

The primary human race are using the old portraits from before 3.4 as base and have 70 portraits that replace the standard ones.

The secondary human race is using the new human portraits and have 30 portraits replacing the standard ones.

[b]Put this mod after the clothing mods in the modlist.[/b]

They use the standard animations and alpha mask from the original portraits so they should be compatible with clothing and hair mods as long as they don't change or replace the characters.

This mod only changes the characters face and body and does not add any clothing and/or hair.

The mod is achievements compatible as well as save game compatible.

The mod shouldn't change the version number of the game so it should work with multiplayer without everyone needing the mod.

title: Immersive Galaxy - Planet Variety, Clouds
description:
[h1]DON'T SUBSCRIBE THIS ALONE[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c65MtHl.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MHQvkfj.png[/img]

PDX textures are quite good, but they lack variety. Continental planets feel all the same, with little personality and color variance, the worse being the gas giants. Planet Variety aims to greatly enhance the visuals of Stellaris by bringing some much needed visual variety for planets.

This mod only contains the new clouds required for the various planet packs to work, and will be useless alone, please subscribe to the planet pack you want

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3mUPw2P.png[/img]

This mod brings a total of [b]353[/b] new planets, and over a thousand new textures to for Arid, Desert, Savannah, Alpine, Arctic, Tundra, Continental, Ocean, Tropical, Gaïa, Tomb, Barren, Cold Barren, Frozen, Gas Giant, Molten, shielded, machine and toxic planets.

No texture overwritten, just more added.

This mod only contains the clouds (a shared dependency for all the planet packs), and you'll need to take either the 2K or 4K mod. I advice taking the 2K mod, for the difference with 4K resolution is very hard to discern unless you zoom very close.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1085907846][img]http://i.imgur.com/QOWwyQk.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1085848794][img]http://i.imgur.com/grtVC9V.png[/img][/url]

For those with performance issues :

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1090786705][img]http://i.imgur.com/fmjzNcd.png[/img][/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ov0QyWq.png[/img]
The mod is [u]completely save game compatible[/u], you can activate/deactivate the mod without any impact, the game will take care of swaping textures/entities. A new game is required to have the textures applied.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fU7aGnH.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1128927140][img]https://i.imgur.com/LYRHaeq.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1173995428][img]https://i.imgur.com/Fmk5em0.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1242221332][img]https://i.imgur.com/db6bSym.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1412637064][img]https://i.imgur.com/ww6WKBK.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445668908][img]https://i.imgur.com/aDTLICW.png[/img][/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5dSrh9R.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/JYmFoSu.png[/img] Achievment compatible.

This mod, as it stands, should NOT conflict with [u]ANY[/u] other mod.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url]: Compatible, there is no conflict.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937289339]Real Space[/url]: Compatible, RS will overwrite several gas giants.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=731621473]Real Sol Textures[/url]: Compatible, there is no conflict.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=948359179]Planetary Shields/MEM[/url]: Compatible, there is no conflict with the new shields.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8xdKLsr.png[/img]
You can DL the mod in one go [url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?threads/mod-immersive-galaxy-planet-variety.1036372/]here[/url], on the PDX official forum, you need to be registered and logged in to have access.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jJ5MXKG.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]2.1:
Barren planet update:
 - 10 new barren planets
 - 10 new cold barren planets
    [*]2.0:
Major rework of the way the mod works :
 - Base has been renamed Clouds, still required for other planet variety mods to work, it is a shared dependency. (580 Mb)
 - "Uninhabitable pack" is now the "2K pack", contains ALL the textures for ALL planets in the 2K resolution. (1.62 Gb)
 - "Inhabitable pack" is now the "4K pack", contains ALL the textures for ALL planets in the 4K resolution. (2.96 Gb)
 - LITE has been reworked a bit and received the new normal maps. (650 Mb)
 - The modular packs are dropped.
Bug fix :
 - ALL normal maps corrected (they were inverted due to openGL/Dx fuckery).
 - Many specular reworked and fixed.
 - Many seams corrected.
Optimization :
 - Removed normal maps for gas giants.
New planets :
 - 5 new alpine planets
 - 5 new arctic planets
 - 5 new barren planets
 - 5 new desert planets
 - 5 new gaia planets
 - 15 new gas giants planets
 - 5 new molten planets
 - 5 new savannah planets
 - 5 new toxic planets
 - 5 new tundra planets
 - 4 new machine planets
New clouds :
 - Final rework for the clouds, all of them have been hand drawn. No more procedural generation. Last time I have to do this hopefully.
    [*]1.2:
- New Toxic planets, 11 new planets added to the existing 4. (concern only uninhabitable)
- New Shielded planets, 4 new planets added to unique one. (concern only uninhabitable)
    [*]1.1:
Optimization:
 - Clouds cut down to 4K for diffuse, 2K for normal, and 1K for shadows (was mistakenly in 8K, should greatly improve performance).
 - Clouds texture variety down, from 35 to 15.
 - Base mod size down to 210 Mo (from 1500 Mb).
Various :
 - Clouds entirely redone, they're more aesthetically pleasing with more transparency.
 - Tomb world variety now 10 (was 6).
 - Made some planet packs standalone (barren, cold barren, molten, gas giant & tomb).
 - Renamed textures to enhance mod compatibility.
 - Save game enabler available, to put new texture on a old save.
 - Lite version released, half the textures for less powerful computers.
[/list]

title: (-United Traits-)
description:
This mod contains 70+ traits for species inspired by various Sci-Fi themes (from Star Wars, Mass Effect, Star Trek, Doctor Who, Stargate, StarCraft to Fallout). New traits are defined in a separate file, therefore vanilla traits are not affected. These traits are more or less balanced according to initial game traits. Exact machine traits are slightly better to make game more balanced. 

Supported languages are English, German, French, Spanish and Russian. Please contact me if you can translate to another language supported by the game.

Please let me know if you want some area covered by a new trait ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133255603283620435]discussion link[/url]). You can let me know your comments regarding balance here: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133255603283907378]discussion link[/url].

List of traits: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133256080237597433] link to discussion[/url].

[h1] Change log:[/h1]
V 1.0: 24 traits added.
V1.1: 10 new traits were added: slaver, grunt, loyalist, rebel, scavenger, hive, clone, advanced engineer, advanced sociologist and advanced physicist. Trait robot tuned.
V1.2: 11 new traits added: small creature, big creature, wanderer, hedonist, extreme harvester, super efficient, survivalist, obnoxious, replicator, prey and unreliable.
V1.3: 13 new traits added: ancient, parasite host, criminal, lawful, exterminator, invasive, fanatical, self-sufficient, mercenary, servant, mineral consumer, food consumer and energy consumer.
V1.4: several traits were revised to be more diverse and balanced.
V1.5: updates implemented for 1.5 Banks, ethics attraction and consuming of goods modifiers have been added to traits, happiness modifiers to other species updated according to vanilla game. Hive mind ethics considered when traits are selected. New traits individualist, collectivist and psi-gifted have been added.
V1.6: 4 new unity traits added: united, extremely united, divided, extremely divided. Previous traits also received modifiers regarding unity and food output when they are consumed.
V1.7: 7 new machine traits added:  super efficient processors, inefficient processors, super inefficient processors, extreme mass produced, extreme custom made, completely recycled, super luxurious.

[h1] Trait Hive [/h1] 
The mod has trait Hive which was created before Utopia :). Also it allows highly unified play style without negative/positive features of Hive-mind and it is an option for players who do not have Utopia.

[h1] Please check out my mods:[/h1]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814332008] United Sci-Fi races (200+ races) [/url] 
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=850721710] United traits (70+ traits) [/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=873063455] Extended Vanilla Clothes (1100+ clothes)[/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1142647596] United Sci-Fi: Robots (includes extended SD portraits) [/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814854383] United Flags (various Sci-Fi and other flag collection)[/url]
• [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1588415009] United Small Tweaks (minor changes for gameplay)[/url]
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766559290] Better map - significantly better display of empires in the map.[/url]
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2028840023] Pirates Removed - pirate mechanic disabled.[/url]

[h1] Conflicts with other mods[/h1]
The mod adds only new traits and increases window for modification of species. Only possible conflict if the same trait (names match exactly) is added by another trait mod. In case other mod changes window it depends what is changed if only interface\species_mod_window.gui it should not cause conflicts.

[h1] Also big thanks for [/h1]
• Translation to Russian by CT-3007 and nidhegg.anth;
• Translation to Spanish by (Es)ven Hassel;
• Translation to German by Maboy;
• Translation to French by Age of Sigmar.
